en.SkinDesc_Default_10000: Shelda always stands against enemies at the front line of the battlefield to honor her father, a legendary war hero.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10010: Daniel, the Captain of the Paladins, led numerous battles against the monsters. His old friend Alberon claims to have used half of his mana to heal him.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10020: Leonhardt, the former Captain of Emperor's Royal Guard, joined the mercenaries to keep the northern monsters at bay after his retirement. As a seasoned warrior, he acts as an adviser for young warriors.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10030: Evan, a talented swordman and tactician, ascended to the position of Knight Commander at such a tender age.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10040: Priya, one of the most naturally talented elven mages, aims to become a true mage. She intends to learn from the world itself, rather than the mages of her own kind.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10050: Aramis the Hawk Eye never misses a target, no matter how far it is, thanks to the sharpshooting technique that he honed from a young age.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10060: Born with incredible Most High power, Alberon was raised to become a priest of the Holy Church. However, he never wanted to be a priest and is bitter about helping people.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10070: Zuo Yun is a member of the King's Royal Unit, which consists of only those who mastered the martial arts of the Eastern Kingdom. No one is a match for his skills, even within the Unit.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10080: Born between a dragon and a human, Draco cannot wield the full power of a dragon, but his might is still quite formidable.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10090: Bardrey, who admires the beauty of the world, travels from place to place and sings in a heavenly voice. Bardrey's songs are famous for soothing people's minds.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10100: Mara lost her hometown in an invasion led by Southern forces. She gathered those who had burning hatred in their heart and formed a brutal gang of bandits. Now she is seeking ruthless revenge as their leader.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10110: Hansi, who was born and raised in a small village in the Eastern Kingdom with Zuo Yun, is a guardian who has defeated several monster invasions and is an archer with incredible marksmanship.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10120: Lyca is a werebeast who is cursed to take a form of a beast and has been forsaken by the human world. He is searching for the being that cursed his kind.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10140: Jol is known as the Elf's strongest swordsman, but he wants more. He believes that he has to seek out those who are stronger than him and grow by challenging them to reclaim long past glory of the Elves.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10150: Born in the forest, Sha-Sha used to be a little earth spirit in the form of golem small enough to sit on Lily's head. It has grown so big that Lily can mount on it.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10170: Zupitere, a noble from the Southern Empire, was born with lightning in her hand. She can perfectly control her Mana now, but when she was young... Well, it's a long story.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10180: Born in a village of shamans, Asiaq communicates and comforts the dead, but shows no mercy to evil spirits.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10190: The enemies who have experienced the overwhelming power of Behemus, blasting everything in his way with two giant shields, lose heart, just by looking at his black armor.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10200: Although Yeon lost her sight when she was young after being severely wounded during a monster invasion, she can see everything by feeling the waves and the currents of nature.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10210: Being left at the southern outskirts with only a sword as a child, Mel began her journey to the North in search of her past as soon as she came of age. As she overcame all the challenges she encountered in the name of justice, Mel became known as the wandering hero.
en.SkinDesc_Default_10220: Bombie, who had shown great talent in dealing with explosives since childhood, played a great role in stopping the demons with the Northern mercenaries.
en.SkinName_1003000: Evan the Blade of the Empire
en.SkinDesc_1000000: Shelda, who led countless battles to victory, is now called a Celestial Guardian. For her followers, her shield is a symbol of invincibility.
en.SkinDesc_1001000: Daniel became the smiting hammer for the enemies of the Holy Church. His set of cold steel armor matches his stern face, and he shows no mercy to those who violate the church's creed.
en.SkinDesc_1001001: Daniel, a blacksmith blessed by the Most High, wields a hammer embracing the light. His hammer is fearsome for his enemies during the battle; however, it is reliable to his fellows' weapons and armor after the battle, giving ally troops endless reassurance.
en.SkinDesc_1002000: Leonhardt, who was called the Lion Heart, overwhelms the enemy with his unbreakable spirit, no matter how many enemies there are or how brutal the battle might be.
en.SkinDesc_1003000: Evan's reputation reached the Emperor's ears, and he was then made an Imperial Knight. Now he is the Blade of the Empire that defeats anyone who stands in his way.
en.SkinDesc_1003001: Evan is obsessed with bloodthirst and looking for his new victim to wield his bloody sword, leaving justice and honor behind. His sword radiates a bloody red aura everywhere in hunger.
en.SkinDesc_1004000: After spending almost a lifetime to understand the truth of mana, there is no one else more deserving of the title of Archmage than Priya.
en.SkinDesc_1004001:
The sharp ice spear penetrates enemies,
and a swirling frost storm stops the whole world.
en.SkinDesc_1005000: Since joining the resistance against the Empire, Aramis has become the worst nightmare to the Empire's forces.
en.SkinDesc_1006000: Alberon spent his whole life following the teachings of the Holy Church and now preaches about faith as a priest and a crucial member of the Church.
en.SkinDesc_1007000: Impressed by a knight’s pride during his journey, Zuo Yun has decided to join them. Now he wields his spear with the honor and arts of the Eastern Kingdom.
en.SkinDesc_1007001:
- On heaven and earth, I alone am honored -
天上天下 唯我獨尊
en.SkinDesc_1008000: Draco honed his wildness and strength in a dangerous northern forest teeming with evil creatures. His ruthless flame annihilates every living soul that steps into his domain.
en.SkinDesc_1009000: Bardrey wants to test if her music can make kings and nobles, who are surrounded by the most amazing entertainment, dance. She hopes to discover rare instruments and melodies on her journeys.
en.SkinDesc_1010000: Mara was raised by a poor hunter who was a retired war veteran. After her hometown was engulfed in the flames of war, she had to learn to protect herself and wield a sword to survive in the wilderness.
en.SkinDesc_1010001: Mara happened to get a necklace with black color while looting a wagon. the necklace emitted constant dark energy even after being moved to her camp, and the bandits became increasingly imbued with madness.
en.SkinDesc_1011000: Hansi borrowed the power of the Most High and the Holy Church to protect the village. Now she is a guardian of the people and a Watcher for the Holy Church.
en.SkinDesc_1012000: Deep inside Lyca's heart, a hatred for humans who ostracized him still burns. His flaming rage turns into madness when he transforms into his wolf form. When that happens, no one, not even Lyca himself, can control him.
en.SkinDesc_1014000: Jol has conquered the Eternal Forest on the Western reach of the continent and now marches to dominate who oppose him all in his shining armor. His sword is glowing with the power of the Most High, and it shall shake all humans and the monsters of the North.
en.SkinDesc_1014001: Jol, who was revered as the next monarch, touched a forbidden force for the revival of the Elves. Wounds from his sword were no longer recovered, and nothing was left where his army pass through.
en.SkinDesc_1015000: When spring comes to the west Eternal Forest, fairies change their clothes and celebrate the season of birth. Lily also prays for the blooming of the forest with Shasha. May the darkness of the North permeate the Eternal Forest next spring.
en.SkinDesc_1017000:
To learn more powerful magic, Zupitere went to the Mage Guild, located between the West and the South.
She showed her overwhelming talent among the elves and human cadets. Zupitere is expected to become a archmage in the future.
en.SkinDesc_1017001: Zupitere, a genius from birth, despises the incompetent. On the battlefield, she electrocuted her frail enemies countless times and laughed at them. That's why she is called a devil with the face of a girl.
en.SkinDesc_1018000: People of Asiaq's hometown in the northeast have been hunting demons for their life, but also hunted by them. As the power of the demons grew stronger, Asiaq enhanced the power of the wildness. Her cold gaze always stares at the horizon.
en.SkinDesc_1019000: Instead of a black iron shields symbolizing the power and honor of the empire, Behemus jumps toward the battlefield with a pure white shields that protect others and confronts evil.
en.SkinDesc_1020000: The coast at the end of the Eastern continent, where the Yeon grew up, was far from the world. But everything has changed since her village was attacked by the demons.
en.SkinDesc_1021000: Mel has solved many requests and destroyed many evil beings. Everyone praises her name, but she still wields a sword for someone somewhere.
en.SkinDesc_1022000: Bombie, who has learned how to deal with poison following explosives, addicts the enemies with his special poison bomb made with his talents.

en.ArtifactDesc_100: Magical Dust that can be obtained by dismantling Relics.
en.ArtifactDesc_10000:
A great sword that symbolized the power of the Empire.
Black Steel from the Empire is well known for its formidable strength that makes all other steel throughout the entire continent pale in comparison.
en.ArtifactDesc_10010:
An armor given to Knights of the kingdom.
It is regarded as an honorable mark of the knights who serve the kingdom and its people, and to receive it as a reward is the highest honor.
en.ArtifactDesc_10020:
A bow used by the elves of the Eternal Forest.

Without the blessing of the Forest, one could not even pull its string.
en.ArtifactDesc_10030:
A staff crafted from trees that endured the harsh environment of the Frozen Land.
It boasts enormous mana with the incredible power of Nature.
en.ArtifactDesc_11000:
A horn that warns about castle invasions.
It helps defenders respond as quick as possible.
en.ArtifactDesc_11010:
A treasure made for the greedy Goblin King.
Many crowns were made from stolen gold, but none of them were to the Goblin King's liking.
en.ArtifactDesc_11020:
A diary that records the journeys of a renowned adventurer.
The incredible amount of expedition notes ushered in the Age of Expedition.
en.ArtifactDesc_12000:
A holy object that contains hero's starlight.
It strengthens the body and the mind of those who gaze upon its light.
en.ArtifactDesc_12010:
A hammer that emits extreme heat and light.
Ores refined by the glorious energy of the hammer are said to be transformed.
en.ArtifactDesc_12020:
A razor-sharp blade in bloody red.
The wielder will be engulfed with madness, compelled by the bloodthirsty sword's whispers.
en.ArtifactDesc_12030:
A helm filled with holy power of ancient guardian.
The wearer will be blessed by its power and be granted incredible strength like that of a giant.
en.ArtifactDesc_12040: The holder will gain indescribable mana with just a touch, but it corrupts the holder, leading them onto a path of self-destruction.
en.ArtifactDesc_12050:
A golden ring stained with dark desire.
Those who are attracted by the whispers of the ring gain great wealth, but are cursed with insatiable greed.
en.ArtifactDesc_12060:
The contract of mercenaries who are not bound by the any region.
A full refund will be made when the contract is terminated.
en.ArtifactDesc_12070:
An insignia that can only be worn by Imperial elite troops.
Their enemies can feel their own death just by looking at it on the battlefield.
en.ArtifactDesc_12080: A banner that brings militias together. Anyone can be stronger if they fight together—even ordinary villagers.
en.ArtifactDesc_12090:
A bunch of swords that look exactly the same.
There is no one who can predict these rapid blades dancing.
en.ArtifactDesc_13000:
A iron helm that brings strength to the body and mind
The wearer never kneels with an indomitable will.
en.ArtifactDesc_13010:
A shield that is optimized to parry attacks
It can serve as a game-changer in battles through a counterattack.
en.ArtifactDesc_13020:
A very long sharp spear.
This spear allows a preemptive strike outside enemy range.

en.SkinDesc_1023000: Luniare's hometown is cold enough for the sea to be frozen, but every summer, the warm sunlight shines upon the beach. Her tribe holds a summer festival to celebrate precious days.

en.Tower_First_Script0:
Attention, all units. I am Knight Commander Aslyn.
 We are here to conquer this ancient tower that is protected by the spirits of the previous knights and their monarch.
 Yet do not despair, for the Miracle will strengthen our forces.
en.Tower_Long_Desc_0:
The Tower of Trials is the great Crusader King Eldin's sanctuary. The king founded the order of knights and ended the war, uniting the central region.
 
 Eldin and his crusaders had been protecting this tower from the monsters of the north for a long time, thanks to the powerful Miracles.
 
 After Eldin passed away, Queen Eldritch ascended the throne. Having grown lax by the peace brought by the former king, the queen and the nobles of the royal family lost the impregnable sanctuary to the sudden invasion from the north.
 
 Angered by the royal family who had failed to protect the tower and desiring to protect the central region, the crusader king and the heroes of the past returned to the tower.
 
 The heroes and even the monsters who had attacked them in the past now became specters and stop those who climb the tower, controlled by the enraged spirit of the old king.
 
 Although countless monsters and humans challenged the tower in search of royal treasures and the sacred power of Miracles, it remains protected by the awakened crusader king and his formidable trials.
 
 
 --
 And today, the current Knight Commander Aslyn who was once a powerful crusader and fought alongside Eldin, has summoned heroes from all over the continent.
 
 With the help of Aslyn who can use the powerful Miracles of the old crusaders, you must reclaim the tower and let the crusader king and the heroes of the past rest in eternal peace.
en.Tower_Long_Desc_1:
- On each floor of the Tower of Trials, Monarch Eldin's formidable trial awaits you.
 
 - However, Knight Commander Aslyn who used to be a Knight Captain can use one of the powerful Miracles that was once wielded by the former knights.
 
 - Assist Knight Commander Aslyn to clear all floors with your two Troops.
 
 - You can earn more rewards if you clear the floors without being defeated.

en.RogueLikeStoryPanel:
"...The vast darkness that shrouded the sky devoured everything there was."

 
"The Great Rift," that’s what people called it. 

Farmers sowing seeds, merchants selling goods,
heroes charging out into the battlefield, and even monsters...
All it took was a split second for a piece of this world to be sucked into the pitch-black swirl.
 
 
What remained was nothingness, and there the Great Rift planted unspeakable creatures of the void. 
They spewed dark energies that decayed and corrupted everything in their path, and it wasn’t long until the entire continent was devastated.

But there was one hero that remained unscarred by the Great Rift. Now, that hero is stepping out on a journey.
To rescue the friends and companions that had vanished into the rift,
and to find a way to put an end to this disaster, the hero seeks to enter the Great Rift.
 
 --
The Great Rift made sporadic appearances for millennia, swallowing pieces of this world to send them to the otherworldly space that was in its embrace.   
 
Here in the Great Rift, time flows differently, and you may encounter lost technologies, archaic magic and runes, and the disasters of ancient times.
 
Your hero must search the maze-like paths of the Great Rift to rescue companions, equip weapons, and obtain divine powers through relics.
 
And at the end of the rift, there might be a way to shut it down once and for all.

en.OutgameTutorial_40_00:
We meet again, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.
We have recently fended off the invasion of the enemy and recovered the Dominion we once lost.

I shall aid the recovery of your desolated Dominion.
en.OutgameTutorial_40_01: You do not have any Buildings in your Dominion. You can select an empty site and construct various buildings.
en.OutgameTutorial_40_02: First, you must build a Chamber as a focal point to manage your Dominion.
en.OutgameTutorial_40_03:
Constructions require costs to be paid.
My headquarters will aid you with the payment for this construction.
en.OutgameTutorial_40_04: Select the site and construct the Chamber. (You can change the location of the building whenever you want after construction.)
en.OutgameTutorial_40_05:
Your Dominion is fundamentally run by the Vitality that your heroes produce.
Therefore, you must build an Inn to work as a storage for their Vitality.
en.OutgameTutorial_40_06:
Select the site and construct an Inn.
 (You can change the location of the building whenever you want after construction.)
en.OutgameTutorial_40_07:
You can assign heroes in each building to boost its efficiency.
Various effects are applied according to the levels and classes of heroes.
en.OutgameTutorial_40_08:
Your Dominion also has many other buildings you can construct aside from the Chamber and Inn.
I recommend you develop your Dominion in a unique way to enjoy various effects and expand the supply for your battles.

Good luck!

en.TreasureDesc_10000: The Empire's chest armor is forged with the highest quality black iron, which is no exception for ordinary soldiers.
en.TreasureDesc_10001: No knight has missed the stage of the training sword.
en.TreasureDesc_10002: At the Mage Guild of the Empire, staves are researched as thoroughly as magic itself.
en.TreasureDesc_10003: Trainees of the Phoenix family have swung wooden swords countless times to hone their rapid swordsmanship.
en.TreasureDesc_10005: The totem of the Winter Lake Tribe brings peace to all nearby.
en.TreasureDesc_10006: Orcs prove their power by hunting down powerful beasts and taking their molars as trophies.
en.TreasureDesc_20000: The ones called the Shadows of the Empire are after you? How unfortunate... Best of luck to you.
en.TreasureDesc_20001: Survival was never an option when the dragon became the target of Ragnir, the second brother of Orsali.
en.TreasureDesc_20002: Knights of the Central Region practice their skills to pierce through the weak spots in between the joints of solid armor.
en.TreasureDesc_20003: The grand beat of the drum that echoed throughout the mountains of the East mustered courage even within the hearts of those who had lost all hope.
en.TreasureDesc_20004: The armor worn by elf warriors is imbued with magic that amplifies the effects of protection and favorable spells.
en.TreasureDesc_20005: Many of those who constitute the army of the Central Region are commoners who do not possess remarkable strength. However, they rally under the knights' banner, upholding the dignified mission to protect their region, and will not hesitate to fight for honor and glory along with the knights.
en.TreasureDesc_20006: The hammer infused with the power of light, wielded by the Southern Paladins, bring down punishment upon enemies and heals allies.
en.TreasureDesc_20007: A manual of tactics essential for novice mercenaries. Although it contains a variety of seasoned strategies, it repeatedly focuses on the importance of adhering to the basics.
en.TreasureDesc_30000: The first Elven King bestowed powerful swords and bows imbued with the force of the Eternal Forest upon the Watcher Captain of the Royal Guard. However, only the pieces of the sword's blade remained after Aenrath shattered it by Aenrath; Tia, the succeeding captain, inherited the bow.
en.TreasureDesc_30001: The House of Juniper is known for its beautiful swordsmanship, resembling a dance of blooming flowers as their swords and steps blend to become one. When Ren grew to display her swordsmanship for her family, the sword blade passed down for generations was reforged into a weapon customized for her, as was the case for all those in her lineage who had followed the same path.
en.TreasureDesc_30002: A holy relic created by Eldin and his paladins to combat the power of the abyss during the Great Holy War. Only those who possess the power and purity untainted by darkness may draw out the mystical power within the scroll.
en.TreasureDesc_30003: Though the bearer of Mur suffered a stream of strife and war against countless enemies of formidable strength, the black shield and the indomitable will prevailed.
en.TreasureDesc_30004: Among the Black Turtle's five holy objects, the Orb of Water has the power to manifest the inner image of others in the form of water. Most tide masters barely reach the level of creating such images, but Yeon's ingenious skills allow her to maintain their forms while communing with their inner selves at the same time.
en.TreasureDesc_30005: When the void consumes our inner focus, the abyss may peer into us, forcing us to the verge of frustration and collapse through excruciating visions that let us behold nothing but despair. However, if we keep our eyes fixed on the light of hope amid the darkness, we will be able to blind the eyes of the abyss and defeat it.
en.TreasureDesc_30006: A bloodstained orb that absorbs and emanates blood from its surroundings. The might of this blood, which governs the essence of all life, is grotesque yet magnificent.

en.TreasureInformationDesc:
Legacy

You can equip Legacies to heroes to grant them Legacy Effects.
There are Legacies that can only be equipped by heroes of specific classes.


 Legacy Enhancement

Legacies can be enhanced to increase the effectiveness of Legacy Effects.
The enhancement materials for Legacies can be obtained by dismantling Legacies from the inventory or purchasing them from the Shop.


 Tier Transcendence

en.StatInformationDesc_Hp: HP is reduced according to the value displayed after being hit. When HP is depleted, the hero stays defeated during that battle. HP is determined based on various factors, such as the hero's type, base HP according to the level, tier, and HP ratio.
en.StatInformationDesc_Atk: ATK affects the damage of normal attacks and skills with ATK ratios. ATK is determined based on various factors, such as the hero's type, base ATK according to the level, tier, and ATK ratio.
en.StatInformationDesc_MAtk: Spell Power affects the damage of skills with Spell Power ratios, the size of applied buffs, duration, and others. Spell Power is determined based on various factors, such as the hero's type, base Spell Power according to the level, tier, and Spell Power ratio.
en.StatInformationDesc_AttackSpeed: Attack Speed affects the interval between normal attacks. It is determined based on various factors, such as the base Attack Speed according to the hero's type and Attack Speed ratio. Every time a hero's tier increases by one, their Attack Speed increases by 10%.
en.StatInformationDesc_Range: Range indicates the distance reached by normal attacks. It also affects some skills that are influenced by its distance. Range is determined based on the hero's type. The cross shape shows that the hero's range is limited to the indicated number of blocks vertically and horizontally from the hero's position. The grid shape shows that the hero's range reaches anywhere within the area according to the indicated number. If a hero is dragged without dropping, the normal attack range is displayed in red, and the skill attack range is displayed in blue.
en.StatInformationDesc_MoveSpeed: Movement Speed refers to the distance that can be traveled within a time frame. It is determined based on the type of the hero and can be increased or reduced by various factors, such as Relics and skill effects.
en.StatInformationDesc_HybridDrain: HP Drain is the ability to restore a set percentage of the damage dealt as the HP of the hero. If it is specified as Physical/Spell, it applies to the corresponding damage type when restoring the HP. If nothing is specified, it applies to both physical and spell damage.
en.StatInformationDesc_HybridDef: Physical DEF reduces physical damage received by 100 * [Physical DEF] / (900 + [Physical DEF])%. Spell DEF reduces spell damage instead of physical damage. If nothing is specified, the DEF stat will provide both Physical and Spell DEF by the indicated value.
en.StatInformationDesc_Damage: Damage dealt increases or reduces the damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to increase or reduce the damage dealt, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence the damage dealt, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.
en.StatInformationDesc_TakeDamage: Damage taken increases or reduces the damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to increase or reduce the damage dealt, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence the damage taken, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are multiplied by each other.
en.StatInformationDesc_SkillDamageMul: Skill amplification increases or reduces skill damage and the damage derived from such damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to determining skill amplification, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence skill amplification, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.
en.StatInformationDesc_AttackDamageMul: Normal attack amplification increases or reduces normal attack damage and the damage derived from such damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to determining normal attack amplification, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence normal attack amplification, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.
en.StatInformationDesc_MissRatio: EVA grants a chance for attacks to be completely missed when a hero takes damage. If an attack misses, the hero negates all damage along with any accompanying status effects from the attack. The maximum chance to miss is limited to 80%.

en.StatInformationDesc_MCriticalDamageMul: Spell CRIT hits occur during spell attacks at a rate equal to the Spell CRIT Chance, increasing the damage by (25 + [Spell CRIT damage])%. If the physical/spell condition is not specified, the CRIT stat will apply to both Physical and Spell CRIT Chance and damage.
en.StatInformationDesc_DefPen: Menace reduces the DEF of the target dealt damage by the equipped hero for 1.5 seconds. The reduced value is in proportion to the equipped hero's tier (x1 for tiers 1-2, x2 for tiers 3-4, x3 for tiers 5-6, x4 for tier 7). Even if multiple units influence the effect, only the highest DEF reduction value will be applied. The Menace value can be increased or reduced by equipment, accessories, and other factors. Besides its base effect, the Menace value can affect the performance of Legacies, Accessories, and others related to the Menace stat.
en.StatInformationDesc_DefDen_0: Guard increases the DEF of the target that received beneficial effects, such as recovery, Protection gain, and stat increase from the equipped hero for 5 seconds. The increased value is in proportion to the equipped hero's tier (x1 for tiers 1-2, x2 for tiers 3-4, x3 for tiers 5-6, x4 for tier 7). Even if multiple units influence the effect, only the highest DEF increase value will be applied. The Guard value can be increased or reduced by equipment, accessories, and other factors. Besides its base effect, the Guard value can affect the performance of Legacies, Accessories, and others related to the Guard stat.
en.StatInformationDesc_DefDen: Guard increases the DEF of an ally besides the user that received beneficial effects, such as recovery, Protection gain, and stat increase from the equipped hero for 5 seconds. The increased value is in proportion to the equipped hero's tier (x1 for tiers 1-2, x2 for tiers 3-4, x3 for tiers 5-6, x4 for tier 7). Even if multiple units influence the effect, only the highest DEF increase value will be applied. The Guard value can be increased or reduced by equipment, accessories, and other factors. Besides its base effect, the Guard value can affect the performance of Legacies, Accessories, and others related to the Guard stat.
en.StatInformationDesc_SpecialDamageMul: Special damage is increased or reduced according to its relevant value. Special damage refers to any white damage derived from physical or spell damage. The amount of special damage is in proportion to the physical or spell damage that was originally dealt. Effects that increase special damage can be obtained from Accessory options and set effects. When multiple factors influence special damage, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.

en.TerritoryTycoonDescription:
- Beach Festival
Welcome to King God Castle's Summer Beach Festival. Construct buildings using Event Tokens and obtain Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens to buy items at the Beach Festival Shop!

- Event Token
At the Beach Festival, you can use Event Tokens to construct buildings. You can earn Event Tokens in content that requires Supplies, including Invasion, Investigation Team, and the Great Rift.

- Manage Buildings
You can construct buildings via "Manage Buildings." The buildings consist of Fisher, Stall, and Store, which can be constructed on Fishing Site, Stall Site, and Store Site, respectively. Please note you can only construct one of each building.

- Festival Level
Festival levels increase whenever you construct two buildings. The buildings you can build become more diverse as your festival level grows.

- Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens
The festival buildings produce a certain number of Bronze, Silver, or Gold Tokens per hour. The produced Bronze and Silver Tokens are collected automatically, while Gold Tokens must be claimed by tapping the token button.

- Festival Missions
Clear a wide range of daily and festival missions to obtain various currencies, including Event Tokens in addition to Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens!

- Festival Shop
Purchase consumables, summoning currencies, skins, and more using the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens you've claimed!

en.Cutscene_10000_10: We are ready to open the dimension gate to the void.
en.Cutscene_10000_20: All right, go ahead and open it.
en.Cutscene_10000_30: Commander Evan, lead your knights back to the central region. After that, focus on defending against the monsters that emerged from the rift.

en.Cutscene_10000_100: We will lead the remaining imperial forces back to the capital.
en.Cutscene_10000_110: What? Why are we going back when we should also head inside the root out the problem?

en.Cutscene_10000_140: What will you do, former prince?

en.Cutscene_10000_190: Ahem! We can't give up on the ancient relics from the kingdom of gold. Supplies will be handled by us.
en.Cutscene_10000_210: You know there's no need to ask me. I'm going to avenge Kalina.
en.Cutscene_10000_220: Well, it seems like it's our turn to decide.
en.Cutscene_10000_230: It's times like these when our small group of elites is useful. Why don't we place our trust on the heroes that are still in the east and bring an end to our ill-fated relationship with Byakuren?
en.Cutscene_10000_240: Haha, that is an unusual decision by you.
en.Cutscene_10000_250: Okay! Time to show off our abilities!
en.Cutscene_10000_260: We're not going on a vacation.
en.Cutscene_10000_270: Still, it's reassuring to have Haerang and Zuo Bai join us.
en.Cutscene_10000_290: It looks like our course has been decided. Crusaders of the central region, raise your swords. All heroes who share our resolve, join us!

Your Majesty,

en.OutgameTutorial_30_02: Here, you can try summoning to obtain new heroes.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_04: Summoning provides a more enhanced effect every 4 times.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_10: Let's level up the summoned hero Chung Ah.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_11: You can level up heroes using the Hero Growth button.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_12: Leveling up requires a certain amount of EXP for each level.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_13:
EXP can be obtained from Invasion, summoning, etc.
Even if there is no EXP for the hero, it is possible to convert using the items below into EXP.

This time, I will provide the necessary EXP.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_14:
If you have the required EXP,
you can level up by paying Gold and pressing the Level Up button.

I will also provide the necessary Gold.
Please press the Level Up button.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_15:
Each time you level up a hero, their various stats increase.

You can close the window by pressing the Confirm button.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_16:
Upon reaching a certain level,
each hero gains an additional effect called Potential Ability.
en.OutgameTutorial_30_17: Now, please register the leveled up Chung Ah to the Troop.
en.OutgameTutorial_100_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

I will show you how to use the item you obtained,Cube of Power.
en.OutgameTutorial_100_01:
Cube of Power is one of the ways to level up a hero.

It is an item that can substitute the EXP and Gold required for hero level-up.
en.OutgameTutorial_100_02:
Cube of Power can be used on the hero level-up window.

Please select Chung Ah.
en.OutgameTutorial_100_03: There are several ways to level up the heroes of King God Castle.
en.OutgameTutorial_100_04:
There is also Shard of Growth that substitutes the Gold cost required for hero level-up,

Cube of EXP that allows you to obtain the EXP required for hero level-up,

and Cube of Power that can substitute both the Gold and EXP required for hero level-up.
en.OutgameTutorial_100_05: Among them, Cube of Power is only applicable to heroes at level 9 or below.
en.OutgameTutorial_100_06:
I hope you quickly power up your heroes and defend the castle by using Cube of Power.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_110_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

The new mode Expedition has been unlocked! Let me briefly explain about the Expedition.
en.OutgameTutorial_110_01:
Expedition is a game mode that can be played with different rules from Invasion.

To play Expedition, you need the exclusive resource Expedition Flag.
Every day, 6 Flags are recharged.
en.OutgameTutorial_110_02:
Each Expedition has different game rules,
and the Expeditions you can play vary by day of the week.

You can obtain various rewards in Expeditions.
en.OutgameTutorial_110_03: In Golblin Hunt Down!, you can obtain Gold after defeating the golblins.
en.OutgameTutorial_110_04: In Elite Invasion!, you can obtain Book of EXP after defeating the powerful enemies of each invasion.
en.OutgameTutorial_110_05: In Hero Invasion?!, you will face other heroes and can obtain Pass Points.
en.OutgameTutorial_110_06:
I hope you defend the castle successfully by obtaining the desired items from Expeditions each day of the week.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

I came after hearing the news that the new region Tower of Trials has opened.
Let me guide you through the Tower of Trials.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_01: Tower of Trials is a new game mode with a play style different from Invasion.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_02: Press the Enter button to enter the Tower of Trials.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_03:
Tower of Trials consists of one battle per floor.
Each time you clear a floor, you will move onto a higher floor.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_04:
In Tower of Trials, equipment with fixed effects is provided,
and you can check it here.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_05:
In Tower of Trials, Altar effects are not applied.
You will set up heroes and Relics for battle.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_06:
After entering, you can proceed with the battle manually.
There is also an Auto-Proceed feature where heroes battle automatically.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_07:
If you clear a floor,
you can obtain the following rewards.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_08: If you purchase the Tower of Trials Pass, you can also obtain the following additional rewards.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_09: Tower of Trials exists in each region.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_10:
For example, unlike the "Tower of Trials" where you could select all heroes,

in the {0}, only {1} region heroes can be selected.
en.OutgameTutorial_120_11:
I hope you conquer all the Towers of Trials.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

I came after hearing the news that you can now join an.
Let me guide you through the Alliance.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_01:
An Alliance is a place where you can interact and cooperate with other kings.

You can exchange conversations with each other,
and through Alliance support, you can complement each other's lacking Hero EXP.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_02:
Additionally, through Alliance Raid and Alliance skills, etc.,
you can gain various beneficial effects by cooperating with each other.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_03: Here, you can search for a specific Alliance and join.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_04:
Additionally, to find an Alliance suitable for you,

you can set the language primarily used in the Alliance and
the keywords pursued by the Alliance.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_05:
By clicking on the Alliances here, you can check the info of each Alliance,
and you can also join one.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_06: If there is no Alliance to your liking, you can create one yourself.
en.OutgameTutorial_130_07:
I hope you can enhance your reputation by being part of an Alliance that overcomes hardships together.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_150_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

{0} has reached level 16 and can now be Awakened.
Let me guide you through Awakening.
en.OutgameTutorial_150_01:
When a hero is Awakened, they can use one of the two Awakened Abilities to become more powerful.
Please check each Awakened Ability.
en.OutgameTutorial_150_02:
To use these abilities, you must Awaken the hero.
You can proceed with Awakening through Hero Growth, similar to leveling up.
en.OutgameTutorial_150_03:
To Awaken a hero, in addition to the EXP and Gold,
you need an item called Hero's Token.
Hero's Tokens possessed by the hero are displayed in the designated area.
en.OutgameTutorial_150_04:
You can obtain Hero's Tokens mainly from Hero Summon,
and you can also convert King's Tokens below to Hero's Tokens.
en.OutgameTutorial_150_05:
Additionally, Hero's Tokens are used not only for Awakening,
but also for level-up after Awakening.
en.OutgameTutorial_150_06:
I hope you have an easier time defending the castle
by using the Awakened Abilities of heroes.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

Let me guide you about forging Relics.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_01:
Forging is a way to make Relics stronger.

I will explain using the Relic I have.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_02: Forging is a system that allows you to change the Relic options, through which you can maximize synergy with heroes.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_03: Forging is only possible for King God Relics. You can enter the forging window by pressing the Forge button.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_04: Through forging, the following options are all changed randomly.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_05:
If there are options you do not wish to change,
you can press the lock button on the right to keep those options.
If more options are locked, the forging cost increases.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_06: If you have decided on the options to change, now select the material.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_07:
You can add a same Relic or Forge Stone in the material slot.

The higher the grade of the selected material, the lower the forging cost.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_08:
Then, you can select a Catalyst.
A Catalyst can adjust the values of the changing options to some extent.
Depending on the type of Catalyst, it can make only specific types of options appear,
and it can also make only options of specific phases or higher appear.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_09: Let's use the King God Shining Catalyst that makes all options appear only at phase 3 or higher.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_10:
If you have decided on the options to change, the material, and the Catalyst, you can now pay the cost and start forging.
You can start forging by paying with Gems or Gold, but if you use a high-grade Forge Stone like now, the cost becomes 0.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_11: Press the Yes button to start forging.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_12: If you have forged, you can compare the Relic before forging and after forging.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_13:
Each time you forge, a value called Forging Energy increases.
When this Forging Energy reaches 100%,
you obtain a Polishing Stone, a material that allows you to change Relic options.

I will explain 'polishing' and 'Polishing Stones' later.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_14:
You can immediately retry forging by pressing the Reforge button.
You can check the materials, Catalysts, and currency consumed during forging here.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_15: If you think the options after forging are better, you can press the After button to change the Relic to those options.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_16:
Conversely, if you think the options before forging are better, you can press the Before button to keep the options as they are.

I will press the Before button to keep the options.
en.OutgameTutorial_160_26:
I hope your Relics also become stronger through forging.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

This time, let me guide you about polishing Relics.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_01:
Polishing is a way to perfect forged Relics.

I will explain using the Relic I have.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_02:
Polishing, like forging, is only possible for King God Relics,
and it can be done in the following location.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_03: First, I will select one of my Relics.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_04:
When you use polish, you can select one of the Relic's options,

and perform one action between Enhance and Move Position.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_05: Enhance enhances the selected Relic option by one phase.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_06:
If you select Move Position,
it moves the position of the selected Relic option.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_07: I will use Enhance among these to enhance the Relic option to a higher phase.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_08: Polishing uses Polishing Stones that can be obtained during forging.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_09:
Each Polishing Stone fills the Polishing Gauge by a set value.

The Polishing Gauge varies depending on the selected option's phase and other factors.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_10:
If the gauge is full, you can start polishing.

You can preview the results of polishing here.
en.OutgameTutorial_170_11: My Relic has become a bit more perfect this way!
en.OutgameTutorial_170_12:
I hope you will also perfectly defend the castle with Relics that have become more perfect through polishing.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_180_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

Now, you are qualified to participate in .
en.OutgameTutorial_180_01:
Strife Battlefield is a mode where you compete in real time by interacting with other kings.

In Strife Battlefield, you send monsters to other kings
and defend against monsters sent by other kings.
en.OutgameTutorial_180_02:
You can select the Troop to use in Strife Battlefield.

This slot reflects the settings of the Barracks slots but does not affect the Barracks slots in return.
en.OutgameTutorial_180_03:
In Strife Battlefield, there is a system called Hero Stats Adjustment.

Certain heroes can perform better in Strife Battlefield.
en.OutgameTutorial_180_04: Here, you can check the current stats adjustment of the heroes in the Troop you have selected.
en.OutgameTutorial_180_05: Additionally, by pressing this button, you can check the current stats adjustment of all released heroes.
en.OutgameTutorial_180_06:
In Strife Battlefield, you are primarily matched with random opponents,
but you can also gather with desired kings to proceed with a Friendly Battle.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

I would like to show you how to transcend the Legacy you have obtained.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_01:
Tier transcendence is a system that can grant additional effects to the abilities of a Legacy.

Please tap on a Legacy to check its info.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_02: Here, you can easily check the transcendence effects.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_03: Press the Tier Transcendence button to transcend the tier of the selected Legacy.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_04: All Legacies can go through a total of 10 tiers of transcendence.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_05:
Each time you transcend the tier of a Legacy,

you can grant additional effects to the Legacy.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_06:
Additionally, when a Legacy's transcendence tier increases,

the maximum level of a Legacy increases in proportion to its rarity.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_07: To transcend the tier of a Legacy, you must use an identical Legacy as material.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_08:
If you do not have an identical Legacy,

you can use a special item called Transcendence Ingot as material.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_09:
Transcendence Ingot can be used as material for any Legacy,

but the cost of selecting materials may increase depending on the rarity.
en.OutgameTutorial_190_10:
You can now transcend your Legacies to defend your castle more effectively.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

Let me guide you about enhancing Accessories.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_01:
Accessories have their own levels, and you can enhance them by leveling them up.

Please select an Accessory.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_02: You can level up Accessories using the Enhance button.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_03: Here, you can proceed with the enhancement.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_04:
The secondary stat of an Accessory is unlocked based on the rarity and level of the Accessory.

Each time you level it up, the following secondary stats are added or enhanced.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_05: When the accumulated EXP on an Accessory exceeds a certain amount, the level of the Accessory increases.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_06:
By selecting enhancement materials, you can grant EXP to an Accessory.

The enhancement material, Accessory Piece, can be obtained by dismantling other Accessories.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_07: When enhancing Accessories, a certain amount of Gold is also required in addition to enhancement materials.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_08: Additionally, you can automatically select materials to quickly increase to the corresponding level.
en.OutgameTutorial_200_09:
I hope you defend the castle with greater strength through enhancing Accessories.

Good luck.
en.OutgameTutorial_20_10:
When you equip a Relic, there is an effect that grants additional stats to heroes besides the basic abilities.

This is called Relic option.
en.OutgameTutorial_20_11:
Relic options have effects that increase HP, ATK, Attack Speed, and Spell Power,

and grant these additional effects to heroes in the following positions.
en.OutgameTutorial_20_13:
Relic options are unleashed one by one as the Relic's tier increases,

and when reaching the highest tier, King God Tier, each Relic can receive 4 Relic options.

en.RogueLikeEvent_10320_Desc:
Two dice are resting on the ancient Altar of Mage.
The inscription on the Altar reads:

"I bestow upon thee a sorcery, guided by fate' hand."
en.RogueLikeEventResult_HighEliteReward_Tri: Receive a stronger elite selection reward three times!
en.RogueLikeEventResult_HighEliteReward: Receive a stronger elite selection reward!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10330_Desc:
You find a treasure chest near a sleeping monster.

You may be able to take the treasure before the monster wakes up.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10331_Desc:
The monster is still sleeping!

It looks like you can try taking another treasure.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10340_Desc:
A blacksmith, retired from civilization, offers his aid.

"What can I do for you? Is there a piece of equipment you'd like me to temper?"
en.RogueLikeEvent_10350_Desc:
You hear a voice beyond the closed door.

"Could you open this door, sir?
Apologies for the delay—I got lost along the way!"

The voice sounds familiar, but you cannot lower your guard.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10350_OpenShop: You open the door and see the shopkeeper standing before you.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10350_Battle: You open the door, ready for battle, and a horde of monsters charge at you!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Desc:
A man, his scent thick with medicine, appears with an offer.

"Why don't you take part in my research? I swear, I'll enhance every part of you!"
en.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Change_Desc: Randomly enhance equipped equipment and Runes.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Change_Narrative:
KABOOM!

The man douses your equipment in mysterious liquid,
and then an explosion erupts, sending a green cloud billowing through the air!

When the smoke clears, you notice that all your equipment and Runes have completely transformed!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Result_Change_Desc:
All equipped equipment and Runes are transformed
into random equipment and Runes that are 1 tier higher.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10370_Desc:
You find a chest that can be opened by letting blood.

Immense rewards lie dormant within, but to claim them, a great blood sacrifice must be made.
en.RogueLikeEventResult_10370_Open:
The chest finally opens,

but your heroes suffer grievous wounds!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10380_Desc: You come across a suspicious man who claims he can create a flawless copy of anything.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10380_Result_Duplicate_De: Select a Rune or equipment at God tier or below to make its copy.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10380_Result_Fail_Desc: Select a Rune or equipment at God tier or below to reduce its tier by 1.
en.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_success_Narra:
"Haha, relax! To me, this is as easy as taking candy from a baby!"

The replication succeeds!
en.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_Fail_Narrativ:
"Huh? How did this happen? Ugh, this must be my unlucky day."

The man damages your item and vanishes...
en.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_success: Obtain an item that is an exact copy of the equipment/Rune you selected.
en.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_Fail: The tier of the equipment/Rune you selected decreases by 1.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10390_Desc:
You stumble upon a small, silent shrine.

It seems to offer a divination service in exchange for Silver.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10390_Result_Omikuji_Desc: Donate {0} Silver and unveil your fate.
en.RogueLikeEventResult_AddAllRewardBuff: Obtain +{0}% Silver, HP Recovery, EXP rewards ({1} round(s))
en.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Desc:
A Golblin greets you with an enticing offer.

"Welcome! We've got some especially tempting goods, just for you! And just this once, I'll let you have 'em for free!"
en.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Invest_Desc: Obtain King tier Saving Rune x{0}
en.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Invest_Succe: You took the Golblin's offer, and it paid off!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Listen_Name: Ask the Golblin about their secret to success.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Listen_Narra: You asked the Golblin to share his secret to success!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Attack_Narra: You attacked the Golblin and obtained Silver!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Invest_Fail: Unfortunately, the investment failed, and the Golblin ran away...
en.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Desc:
"I'm furious! Absolutely livid!"

A man rants, overcome with anger.
en.RogueLikeEventResult_EliteReward_Twice: Receive an elite selection reward twice.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Talk_Narrati:
"Seems I let anger get the best of me. My apologies."

Thanks to you, the man regains his composure, leaving behind a small token of gratitude before departing.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Talk_Reroll: Change the probability of the other two choices.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10411_Desc:
"Listen, this is just absurd! It just makes no sense!"

The man seems to be angry still.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_GiveMoney_Su:
"I...don't know why you're giving me this Silver, but...you've managed to calm me down."

The man is perplexed by your action but hands you a small reward after calming down.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_GiveMoney_Fa:
"Are you taking me for a beggar?!"

The man starts cursing at you out of anger.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Attack_Succe:
With no other options to pacify him, the heroes take up their arms.

They succeed in subduing the man...but not without suffering wounds.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Attack_Fail:
You dare raise your weapons against me?!

Seeing your heroes prepare for battle,
the man charges at them, inflicting serious wounds.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10420_Desc:
You encounter a monster and hastily ready yourself for battle,

but the monster merely twirls its hand and says,

"I can't be bothered to fight, so why don't you just keep going your way? All I want is to lie here a while longer."
en.RogueLikeEvent_10420_Result_Attack_Narra:
"Ugh, how annoying..."

Frustrated by your decision, the monster imbues its hand with magic and waves it.

A sudden wave of lethargy grips the heroes, just as a swarm of monsters ambushes them!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10430_Desc:
A figure approaches you with a bottle.
It exudes a sweet aroma.

"I bring you an offer you can't refuse. Drink."
en.RogueLikeEvent_10430_Result_Drink_Narrat:
Upon drinking the liquid from the bottle, your heroes feel their blood surge.

"Sweet things often mask hidden dangers. Enjoy."

With those parting words, the figure vanishes.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Desc:
"You there, I find myself rather thirsty. Fetch me some tea, at once."

A man, draped in garments so lavish they seem freshly woven from the crack in the Rift, is sitting gracefully and gazing down at you.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_GiveItem_Hid:
The man takes the potion and speaks with a satisfied look.

"Impressive. You shall be rewarded accordingly."
en.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_TakeRewardHi: Receive a selection reward of a higher Tier!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_GiveItem_Nar:
"I made it clear I was thirsty. Nonetheless, I shall accept this gift with gratitude. Take your reward."

The man hands you Silver with a hint of dissatisfaction and departs.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_Attack_Narra:
"You would strike a man when he is at a disadvantage?!"

Furious, the man breaks past your heroes and flees.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_Ignore_Fail:
"Such insolence! You dare ignore me?!"

You try to ignore the man, but he lunges at you in a fury.
You and your heroes manage to retreat, but one suffers injuries in the process.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Desc:
A monster gnawing on a piece of iron shouts at you.

"Help! I'm starving to death! Give me something—anything—to eat!"
en.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Result_GiveItem_Low:
"Graaack! It's not enough!"

The monster devours your items, yet its hunger seems to be unquenched.
It clutches its hungry belly and vanishes into the unknown...
en.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Result_GiveItem_Nor:
"Whew, you saved me. I thought I was done for."

With its hunger sated, the monster seems eager to offer you a reward.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Result_GiveItem_Hig:
"That was a feast to remember!"

The monster pats its belly and continues.

"As a reward, I'll grant you tiny bits of my scales!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Desc:
A man, carrying an abundance of Runes under his clothes, walks toward you and yells.

"Your Runes look way better than mine! Let's trade!"
en.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Result_ChangeRune_L:
Following the exchange, the man carefully examines the Rune and says,

"Wait a minute... This is worse than what I gave you! Ugh, dang it!"

The man storms off in anger.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Result_ChangeRune_H:
Just as the exchange takes place, the man suddenly snaps.

"No, I change my mind! I'm taking yours and keeping mine!"

In greed, he summons monsters and attacks you!
en.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Result_HasNoRune_De:
"Wait, now that I see you more clearly, you have nothing!"

The man gazes at you and hands you a rune before going his way.

"Just toss it aside along the way!"
en.RogueLikeEvent_10470_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

In the center of the rift with a ferocious mana storm,
you see the silhouette of a colossal raptor take shape.
Its form pulses with energy sharp as lightning itself, overflowing with mana.
Then, the entity speaks, its voice echoing like thunder.

"My old comrades, I offer you my power to aid in your journey, should you wish it."

The thunder hawk silently unfurls its wings, preparing to bestow its might upon you.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10470_Result:
"Good! May the winds of fortune carry you ever forward!”

The thunder hawk hands you a radiant feather gleaming with five distinct colors.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10480_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

It is an acrid world with the smell of steel and smoke.
The entity is familiar, yet peculiar.
It resembles the spirit you and your heroes have known,
except its form is made not of stone but of solid steel.
And though its body is of metal, the warmth of its heart is unmatched. Cautiously, it speaks, its voice laced with an electronic sound.

"Expression of will: Joining your journey forward."

The Spirit of Steel readies itself, prepared to remove a part of its own body and give it to you.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10480_Result:
The spirit's part drifts around you.

"Partial synchronization complete. Activating perpetual defense system."

Its voice hums with happiness.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10490_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

It is the Eternal Forest that grew beyond the rules or reasons of the world.
From eternity that silences even silence itself, she gazes upon you,
her presence woven between roots untouched by light and branches tangled endlessly.
Once a tiny spirit of this boundless grove, she has weathered countless cycles of end and beginning, rising at last as its last guardian.
Breaking the silence, she speaks.

"Visitors from another world, I do not wish for you to bear the burden of our sins.”

She unleashes a part of her strength from the forest and gives it to you.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10490_Result:
The power she bestows takes form. It is a flower.

"Worry not, visitors. Every spirit of the Eternal Forest will come to your aid."
en.RogueLikeEvent_10500_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

His form resembles someone who has succumbed to power in this world.
Yet, this being from the rift has not yet fallen. He gazes at you with deep eyes and speaks.

"Through this rift, I glimpsed my future...
and saw that what I accepted was not power
but a catalyst for an endless descent.
As such, I wish to end this path here."

The young prince launches an orb shaped like an eye, ready to accompany you on your journey.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10500_Result:
The eye-like magic orb ascends in silence, casting its light upon the path ahead.
The prince says,

"I shall join you and lend you my knowledge...for my demise."
en.RogueLikeEvent_10510_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

She weeps in silence, clutching a doll tightly in her arms.
Once hailed as the empire's greatest swordswoman, she now carries the weight of failure.
She failed to protect her sibling.
With great effort, she suppresses sorrow and molds it into fury.

"The blood price must be paid for the sake of my ruined world,"
says the avenger as she hands you a dagger, its blades still slick with fresh blood.

"Take it. I shall follow you after spilling blood."
en.RogueLikeEvent_10510_Result:
As you take her dagger,
she turns, striding in the opposite direction. Her eyes burn with resolve.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10520_Title: The Hero and the Dark Lord
en.RogueLikeEvent_10520_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

Once a hero, the Dark Lord completed her world in another rift.
However, her world crumbled within the Dimensional Rift, drowning her in sorrow once again.
The once-hero speaks.

"Do you seek my strength?
Then prove that you have the courage to face it."

The hero, who was once the Dark Lord, prepares to grant you her strength.
en.RogueLikeEvent_10520_Result:
The great power of the world flows into you.

"Go."

With that final word, she vanishes...

The season will be ending soon.

en.OutgameTutorial_140_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. It's been a while. I am Knight Commander Aslyn.

I would like to explain about the Vanguard hero in the Barracks.
en.OutgameTutorial_140_01:
Vanguard hero is one of the elements that can be strategically utilized in King God Castle.

After you start an Invasion or Expedition, when summoning heroes 8 times or less, only the Vanguard hero is summoned.
en.OutgameTutorial_140_02:
By utilizing this, you can designate a Vanguard hero
to start the battle with an advantage.
en.OutgameTutorial_140_03:
Now, let's designate a Vanguard hero.
Please press the Designate Vanguard button.
en.OutgameTutorial_140_04: Please designate one of the deployed heroes as a Vanguard hero.
en.OutgameTutorial_140_05:
Well done.

Only one Vanguard hero can be designated, and you may change to another hero or choose not to designate a Vanguard hero.
en.OutgameTutorial_140_06:
Additionally, if you play with15 points of Altar of Greed,
you can summon heroes 8 times with the initial Silver, allowing you to quickly make use of the strategy.
en.OutgameTutorial_140_07:
I hope you defend the castle successfully by strategically using the Vanguard hero.
Good luck.
en.IngameTutorial_1_01:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Knight Commander Aslyn.

Congratulations on your ascension to the Castellan.
en.IngameTutorial_1_01_2:
King God Castle is a precarious castle frequently besieged by monster invasions. Goblins are trying to breach the castle gate as we speak.

Please, let me explain how to navigate the battle through this round and assist you in defending King God Castle excellently.
en.IngameTutorial_4_1_01:
You obtained a piece of equipment!
Drag the equipment and equip it on a hero.
en.IngameTutorial_4_1_07: Initiate the battle when you are ready.
en.IngameTutorial_4_2_01:
Unfortunately, we lost the battle.

One of our Banners has been lost.

If we lose 3 Banners, we will have to retreat to the gate.
en.IngameTutorial_4_2_02:
When we lose a battle, we get to face the enemies once again.

Even when we are defeated, we will be granted a small amount of Silver so that we can reinforce our Troop.
en.IngameTutorial_4_2_04:
We summoned 2 more of the same hero.
The Goddess of Fortune smiles upon us!

Merge heroes to reach Tier 3
(Drag or double-tap to merge!)
en.IngameTutorial_4_2_05: Now, Mel is stronger than before!
en.IngameTutorial_4_2_06:
When a hero reaches Tier 3, 5, and 7, their skills will be enhanced.

You can click the skill areato see the skill range.

Your Most Highness, please initiate the battle with the enhanced hero.
en.IngameTutorial_5_03: We got some Tier 2 equipment now.
en.IngameTutorial_5_04:
Equipment can be upgraded in the same way as heroes to reach higher tiers.

Go ahead and merge them to upgrade the equipment to Tier 3.
en.IngameTutorial_5_05:
At Tier 3, special effects
are added to the equipment.
en.IngameTutorial_5_06:
Please tap the button
to check the result briefing from the last battle.

marching toward our castle.

you can also proceed with forging to change the Relic options.

en.OutgameTutorial_4_02:

en.OutgameTutorial_30_00: Greetings, King of the Castle. The time has come for you to gain the power of new heroes to face stronger monsters.
en.BeginnerHelp_10100: You can further strengthen a hero by selecting them in the Barracks. As they level up, battles will become much easier. Please empower the heroes!
en.BeginnerHelp_10300: Would you like to use the Altars in the Barracks? They can provide you with power that greatly aids in battle. As you expand the Embers, the Altars also become stronger, making your journey ahead more secure.
en.BeginnerHelp_10500: The Altar Ember can be expanded once each time the Castle level increases. It can be expanded up to a maximum of 25, so take your time to upgrade it. As the Ember grows, the Altars will shine more beautifully.
en.BeginnerHelp_10501: You can retrieve and grant the Altar Ember at any time. Feel free to make use of it.
en.BeginnerHelp_10700: In the Blacksmith of the Barracks, you can craft Relics that provide significant strength in battle. Properly assigning the completed Relics will give you a great advantage in battle!
en.BeginnerHelp_11000: Have you tried opening the Relic Chest in the summoning tab? They are filled with materials necessary for crafting Relics. If you have gathered the materials, try crafting a wonderful Relic at the Blacksmith!
en.BeginnerHelp_11001: Have you visited the Dominion? Constructing buildings in the Dominion can make your heroes stronger.
en.BeginnerHelp_11300:
If you designate a Vanguard hero in the Barracks, that hero will appear first in the first 8 summons after the game starts. Make sure to set it if you want to summon the hero you want quickly.
And... since I am a supporter, please don't send me as a Vanguard!
en.BeginnerHelp_11500: Legacies are special equipment that awaken the true power of heroes. If you equip a hero with a Legacy, they can exert much more powerful strength in battle.
en.BeginnerHelp_11501: Legacies can be enhanced. By enhancing or combining the same Legacy, you will be granted more power.
en.BeginnerHelp_13000: Accessories are precious equipment that draw out the potential of heroes. However, you must clear 'Corruption Invasion II' to obtain them, so prepare well and take on the challenge.

en.KGMarbleEventRuleContent:
Select a hero, roll the dice, and play King God Dice!

Each hero has unique effects, and by rolling the dice, you can encounter various rewards and events.

Each time you reach or pass the starting point and complete a lap, the tiles change randomly, and you can obtain additional rewards based on the number of laps completed.

vi.SkillDesc_25120: Tấn công với tốc độ gấp 2 lần trong {Time} giây.
vi.SkillDesc_25130: Vung nắm đấm gây {Damage:MAtkPer} sát thương và hất bay mục tiêu về phía sau 5 ô.
vi.SkillDesc_25400: Bắn 3 mũi tên ở đòn tấn công thường kế tiếp.
vi.SkillDesc_25421: Sức Mạnh Quân Chủ Elf giúp miễn nhiễm hiệu ứng cản trở.
vi.SkillDesc_25600: Vung mạnh ngọn thương tấn công mọi kẻ địch xung quanh.
vi.SkillDesc_25621: Hất bay kẻ địch xung quanh ra xa {Knockback} ô theo hướng nhìn của bản thân.

vi.Potential_10220_1: Trong khi dùng , thêm sát thương thường phép bằng 100% lực phép cho mục tiêu tấn công
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10000: Để tiếp nối danh dự mà người cha anh hùng chiến trường đã gầy dựng, Shelda luôn sẵn sàng xông pha ra tiền tuyến đối đầu với quân địch.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10010: Daniel là Chỉ huy Đột Kích của Đội Thánh Hiệp Sĩ. Anh đã tiên phong trong vô vàn trận chiến với các ma vật. Người ta cho rằng người đồng sự lâu năm Alberon của Daniel đã dùng cả một nửa ma lực của mình để chữa trị cho anh.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10020: Leonhardt trước kia giữ chức Chỉ huy của đội Cận Vệ Hoàng đế, sau khi về hưu đã gia nhập Binh Đoàn Đánh Thuê chuyên ngăn chặn các ma vật ở phía Bắc. Là một lão tướng trải qua hàng trăm chiến trận, Leonhardt vừa là tiền bối lại vừa là người khuyên bảo của các anh hùng trẻ tuổi.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10030: Evan xuất chúng ở mọi mặt kể cả kiếm thuật lẫn chiến thuật. Dù còn nhỏ tuổi nhưng anh đã kế nhiệm chức Đội trưởng Hiệp Sĩ và là Đội trưởng Hiệp Sĩ trẻ tuổi nhất từ trước đến nay.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10040: Trong số các Elf, Priya sở hữu tài năng thiên phú về phép thuật. Cô coi cả thế giới chứ không phải chỉ riêng các Pháp Sư trong chủng tộc đều là những người thầy của mình. Và mục tiêu Priya đang hướng tới chính là trở thành một Pháp Sư chân chính.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10050: Sở hữu đôi mắt diều hâu cùng tài bắn súng học hỏi được từ khi còn bé, Aramis chưa từng bắn trật bất cứ kẻ địch nào dù khoảng cách có xa hàng vạn dặm.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10060: Alberon sở hữu năng lực thần thánh thiên bẩm đáng kinh ngạc. Dù từ nhỏ đã được nuôi dạy như một linh mục của giáo hội nhưng Alberon cũng không lấy làm vui vẻ khi bản thân buộc phải trở thành linh mục như vậy.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10070: Zuo Yun là thành viên của đội quân trực thuộc Hoàng gia gồm những người tinh thông võ nghệ ở Vương quốc phía Đông. Trong đội quân ấy, không một ai có đủ sức để tỉ thí với Zou Yun.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10080: Draco là thực thể lai giữa rồng và người. Tuy sức mạnh không hoàn hảo như loài rồng nhưng khả năng hủy diệt của anh thì tuyệt đối không thể xem thường.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10090: Vì quá đỗi yêu mến thế gian xinh đẹp này mà Bardrey thường phiêu lưu đó đây và cất lên tiếng hát thiên phú. Khúc ca của cô nổi tiếng là có thể giúp người nghe thanh lọc tâm hồn.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10100: Những con người phía Nam đã tấn công và cướp lấy ngôi làng của Mara. Cô đã tập hợp những người có cùng lòng căm phẫn bọn chúng lại và lập nên một băng cướp để dẫn dắt họ nung nấu ý chí báo thù.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10110: Hansi là người tính tình điềm đạm. Cô và Zuo Yun sinh ra tại một ngôi làng nhỏ phía Đông. Hansi vừa là hộ vệ nhiều lần giúp ngăn chặn các cuộc xâm lược của ma vật, lại vừa là cung thủ có tài bắn cung thuộc dạng bậc nhất.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10120: Lyca là một trong số các thành viên của chủng tộc bị thế giới loài người hắt hủi do hứng chịu lời nguyền trở thành dã thú. Để hóa giải lời nguyền ấy, Lyca phiêu bạt khắp nơi mong tìm được kẻ đã yểm lời nguyền lên chủng tộc của mình.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10140: Tuy được gọi là Kiếm sĩ Elf tuyệt đỉnh nhưng Jol không mấy hài lòng với biệt danh ấy. Anh coi việc trưởng thành trong quá trình tìm kiếm những người mạnh hơn mình chính là nền tảng giúp chấn hưng Elf sau này.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10150: Sha-sha là một Tinh Linh của đất, nhỏ bé đến mức có thể ngồi trên đầu Lily của rừng xanh. Vậy mà giờ đây Sha-sha đã to lớn gấp nhiều lần, thậm chí Lily còn có thể trèo lên lưng của nó.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10170: Zupitere xuất thân là quý tộc ở Đế quốc phía Nam, từ lúc lọt lòng đã nắm giữ tia sét trong tay. Giờ đây cô đã có thể điều khiển được dòng năng lượng, thế nhưng thuở nhỏ khi chưa thể chế ngự được sức mạnh ấy,...
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10180: Asiaq sinh ra tại một ngôi làng của các phù thủy. Cô có thể giao cảm cũng như an ủi các linh hồn đã khuất song lại vô cùng nhẫn tâm đối với những linh hồn gian ác.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10190: Behemus hất bay quân địch bằng hai tấm khiên lớn. Những kẻ đã từng kinh qua thứ sức mạnh áp đảo ấy chỉ cần nhìn thấy bộ giáp đen là đã mất hết ý chí chiến đấu.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10200: Khi còn nhỏ, Yeon từng bị thương nặng trong cuộc tập kích của các ma vật. Tuy đã mất đi thị lực nhưng cô vẫn có thể đọc được cơn sóng và dòng chảy của tự nhiên, nhờ đó mà cảm nhận được vạn vật.
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10210: Mel được phân công hoạt động tại vùng biên giới phía Nam cùng với một thanh kiếm. Năm Mel trưởng thành, cô đã lên đường về phía Bắc để tìm lại quá khứ của mình. Với tấm lòng trượng nghĩa, Mel đã ra tay giúp giải quyết mọi rắc rối gặp phải trong hành trình. Bởi vậy mọi người gọi cô là "Dũng sĩ".
vi.SkinDesc_Default_10220: Bombie đã cho thấy tài năng sử dụng thuốc nổ vượt trội từ thuở nhỏ. Cậu tích cực cùng những người lính đánh thuê ở phương Bắc ngăn chặn lũ ma vật đang ồ ạt tràn vào.
vi.SkinName_1010001: Thủ Lĩnh Bị Xâm Thực Mara
vi.SkinName_1014001: Hoàng Tử Bị Xâm Thực Jol
vi.SkinName_1021000: Chiến Binh Được Lựa Chọn Mel
vi.SkinDesc_1000000: Shelda được gọi là Anh Hùng Hộ Vệ vì đã nhiều lần giành chiến thắng trong các cuộc chiến. Những người đi theo Shelda coi tấm khiên của cô như một biểu tượng vô địch.
vi.SkinDesc_1001000: Daniel trở thành chiếc búa phán quyết giúp đẩy lùi những kẻ địch của giáo hội. Khoác lên mình bộ giáp vững chắc cùng biểu cảm sắc lạnh, anh thẳng tay tàn nhẫn với những kẻ dám chống lại giáo lý.
vi.SkinDesc_1001001: Daniel nhận được ân sủng từ Thần Thợ Rèn. Anh vung chiếc búa rực lửa của mình. Khi chiến đấu, chiếc búa được dùng để tấn công địch, còn ngoài trận chiến nó lại giúp anh luyện vũ khí và áo giáp cho đồng đội, tiếp thêm cho họ sức mạnh vô biên.
vi.SkinDesc_1002000: Leonhardt được gọi là Người Mang Trái Tim Sư Tử. Dẫu quân địch có đông cỡ nào hay thế trận bất lợi ra sao, anh cũng vẫn luôn áp đảo chúng bằng khí thế quật cường.
vi.SkinDesc_1003000: Tin thắng trận của Evan đã đến tai Hoàng Đế. Anh được bổ nhiệm vào Đội Hiệp Sĩ tinh nhuệ nhất của Đế Quốc. Giờ đây, Evan chính là thanh kiếm của Đế Quốc, cho thấy sự nhạy bén hơn người đối với những kẻ gây cản trở cho bản thân anh.
vi.SkinDesc_1003001: Bị cơn khát máu làm điên đảo lí trí, Evan tạm gác lại chính nghĩa lẫn danh dự để đi tìm vật tế mới và thẳng tay vung thanh kiếm thấm đẫm máu. Thanh kiếm đói khát bấy lâu của Evan phun trào ra tứ phía luồng năng lượng đỏ thẫm.
vi.SkinDesc_1004000: Sau bao ngày miệt mài nghiên cứu phép thuật, cuối cùng Priya đã hiểu ra chân lý của dòng chảy năng lượng. Cô quả thật xứng với danh xưng Đại Pháp Sư.
vi.SkinDesc_1004001:
Ngọn thương băng tuyết sắc nhọn đâm xuyên kẻ địch.
Bão tuyết dữ dội như thể đóng băng vạn vật trên thế gian.
vi.SkinDesc_1005000: Aramis đã gia nhập Quân Kháng Chiến nổi dậy chống lại thế lực cầm quyền Đế Quốc. Sự tồn tại của anh chính là nỗi khiếp sợ đối với những kẻ cầm quyền ở Đế Quốc.
vi.SkinDesc_1006000: Alberon trở thành tu sĩ sau khi học giáo lý suốt một thời gian dài. Là một thành viên chủ chốt, Alberon thường thuyết giảng về những lời dạy và tín ngưỡng của giáo hội.
vi.SkinDesc_1007000: Vì quá say mê khí chất của Đội Hiệp Sĩ tình cờ gặp trong chuyến đi nên Zuo Yun đã quyết định gia nhập. Khoác trên mình bộ giáp chứa đựng tài năng võ nghệ của bản thân cùng danh dự của Vương Quốc phía Đông, Zuo Yun xoay cây thương thật tài tình.
vi.SkinDesc_1007001:
- Thiên thượng thiên hạ, duy ngã độc tôn -
天上天下 唯我獨尊
vi.SkinDesc_1008000: Sống trong một khu rừng hoang dã với vô vàn ma vật, Draco đã sớm nuôi dưỡng sức mạnh và đặc tính dã thú trong con người mình. Ngọn lửa sắc lẹm của Draco có thể diệt trừ bất cứ thực thể nào dám xâm phạm lãnh thổ của anh.
vi.SkinDesc_1009000: Trong hành trình phiêu du khắp thế gian, Bardrey đã quyết định thử sức xem âm nhạc của mình có thể khiến các quý tộc và Quân vương nhún nhảy theo hay không, bởi họ vốn thuộc tầng lớp ưa thích thưởng thức nhiều loại hình nghệ thuật. Cô háo hức mong chờ được mắt thấy tai nghe những giai điệu và nhạc cụ quý hiếm của họ.
vi.SkinDesc_1010000: Trước khi quê hương chìm trong biển lửa chiến tranh, Mara được nuôi dạy bởi một người thợ săn nghèo khó vốn là lính đã giải ngũ. Để tồn tại trong môi trường không khác gì hoang dã, cô đã phải học kiếm pháp và nuôi dưỡng cả sự tàn bạo cho mình.
vi.SkinDesc_1010001: Trong lúc đang cướp một xe ngựa chở hàng, Mara vô tình lấy được sợi dây chuyền phát ra ánh sáng đen. Ngay cả sau khi được mang về nơi ở của Mara, dây chuyền vẫn không ngừng giải phóng ra thứ năng lượng u ám, còn băng cướp thì ngày một dấn sâu hơn vào sự điên cuồng.
vi.SkinDesc_1011000: Hansi mượn sức mạnh của thần linh và giáo hội để bảo vệ mọi người. Giờ đây, cô vừa là người bảo vệ cho ngôi làng lại vừa là người cần mẫn giúp giáo hội giữ gìn sự linh thiêng.
vi.SkinDesc_1012000: Lyca mang trong mình nỗi căm ghét sục sôi đối với những con người đã nhẫn tâm hắt hủi anh. Mỗi khi xuất hiện trong hình hài chó sói, nỗi phẫn nộ tựa ngọn lửa dữ trong Lyca liền biến thành cơn điên loạn mà không một ai có thể kiểm soát được kể cả bản thân anh.
vi.SkinDesc_1014000: Sau khi chiếm được khu Rừng Vĩnh Cửu ở phía Tây lục địa, Jol khoác trên mình bộ giáp sáng bóng chuẩn bị lên đường chinh phạt mọi thế lực. Thanh kiếm chất chứa sức mạnh thần linh của anh không chỉ khiến con người mà cả lũ ma vật ở phía Bắc đều run rẩy khiếp sợ.
vi.SkinDesc_1014001: Jol được mọi người nể trọng vì là Quân Chủ kế nhiệm. Để khôi phục lại tộc Elf, anh đã chạm tay vào thứ sức mạnh cấm kỵ. Vết thương gây ra bởi thanh kiếm của Jol không thể nào lành hẳn, và bất kể nơi nào đội quân của anh đi qua cũng đều hóa thành tro bụi.
vi.SkinDesc_1015000: Khi mùa Xuân tìm về với Rừng Vĩnh Cửu ở phía Tây, các Tinh Linh sẽ thay áo mới để đón chào mùa của sự sống. Lily cùng Sha-sha rất mong chờ và cầu nguyện cho thời khắc nở rộ của khu rừng. Cầu cho mùa Xuân năm sau khu rừng cũng sẽ không bị chìm vào bóng tối phía Bắc.
vi.SkinDesc_1017000: Zupitere đã lên đường du học đến Guild Pháp Sư nằm giữa hai miền Tây và Nam với mong muốn học được phép thuật hùng mạnh. Nổi bật với tài năng xuất chúng giữa nhiều học viên Elf và con người, cô được nhận định sẽ trở thành đại pháp sư trong tương lai.
vi.SkinDesc_1017001: Sinh ra đã là một thiên tài, Zupitere luôn khinh miệt những kẻ không có năng lực. Trên chiến trường, cô khiến vô số quân địch yếu ớt bị nhiễm điện và cười nhạo chúng. Thấy Zupitere như vậy, một người nào đó đã gọi cô là ác ma mang gương mặt thiếu nữ.
vi.SkinDesc_1018000: Quê hương của Asiaq ở vùng Đông Bắc, chuyên săn bắt ma vật để phục vụ cho cuộc sống, song ngược lại họ cũng nhiều lần bị săn bắt. Các ma vật ngày càng mạnh bạo hơn, vì vậy Asiaq đã không ngừng ra sức nuôi dưỡng sức mạnh của bản thân. Ánh mắt sắc lạnh của cô luôn nhìn thẳng đến đường chân trời.
vi.SkinDesc_1019000: Thay vì dùng tấm khiên làm từ sắt đen biểu trưng cho sức mạnh và danh dự của Đế Quốc, Behemus nâng tấm khiên trắng tinh xông thẳng vào chiến trường chiến đấu với cái ác để bảo vệ mọi người.
vi.SkinDesc_1020000: Bờ biển ở cuối lục địa phía Đông nơi Yeon lớn lên là một vùng đất tách biệt hoàn toàn với thế giới. Song kể từ sau khi ngôi làng của cô bị lũ ma vật tấn công, mọi thứ đã thay đổi hoàn toàn.
vi.SkinDesc_1021000: Mel đã thực hiện rất nhiều lời nhờ cậy của mọi người cũng như tiêu diệt vô vàn thực thể hiểm ác. Ai ai cũng đều tán dương Mel, nhưng cô vẫn đang miệt mài vung kiếm vì một người ở một nơi nào đó trên lục địa.
vi.SkinDesc_1022000: Sau khi học về thuốc nổ, Bombie còn học cả cách dùng độc. Anh vận dụng tài năng của mình để chế tạo ra loại bom độc khiến kẻ địch trúng độc.
