ar.RogueLikeDesc:
Enter the Great Rift to follow the map and complete your troop.
You will earn better rewards depending on the highest chapter you have cleared in the Invasion mode.
ar.DeleteRogueLikeSaveData:
Do you want to delete the saved data?
After deleting, you can play from the start.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10000_Desc:
Soldiers who are badly wounded ask for your help.

“We cannot go on any longer by ourselves.
If one hero is kind enough to lead us, we will give you the treasure we have.”
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10000_Result_Kill_Desc:
One hero leaves the troop.
Obtain {0} Tier equipment.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10000:
One hero has left the troop to support the remnant soldiers.
They gave you a piece of equipment as a token of their gratitude.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10010_Desc:
Three corrupted imperial soldiers are approaching slowly.
They are drawing their swords to prepare for battle.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10012_Result_win_Name:
You have purified all imperial soldiers!
They are giving you the things they have in return.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10010_Lose:
You were defeated in the battle with the imperial soldiers.
The hero that engaged in the combat takes damage.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10011_GoldReward: You receive Silver as a reward from the purified imperial soldiers.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_UnitDamaged: The hero took damage equal to {0}% of HP.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10011_Desc:
The victory in combat purified the defeated imperial soldier from corruption.
However, two other imperial soldiers still remain.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10011_Result_Ignore_Desc: The purified imperial soldier gives you a reward.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10012_Desc:
The second imperial soldier has also been purified from corruption.
All that is left is the last imperial soldier.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10012_Win: Receive an elite selection reward twice.
ar.RogueLikeCantSellLastHero2: You only have one hero remaining.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10020_Desc:
A suspicious man in a cloak approaches and whispers.

“Say, don't you need this Rune?
I also have more Precious Runes.
I'll treat you at a special price.”
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_GetRandomRune: Purchased Precious Rune from the merchant.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_GetProveRune: Purchased Verified Rune from the merchant.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10030_Desc:
An anvil that looks at least few hundred years old lies in front of you.
The anvil seems to contain magical powers.
However, no one knows whether that power will help you or harm you.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10030_Result_UpGrade_Desc: Select 1 piece of equipment/Rune to increase its Tier by 1
ar.RogueLikeEventOption_DamageToAllHeroPer_: All heroes take damage equal to {0}% of their HP
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10030_Result_Find_Desc: You don't have any items to polish.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_AllUnitDamaged: All heroes took damage equal to {0}% of their HP.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10030_Sucsees:
The anvil glows with its magical power.
Polishing was successful!
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10030_Fail:
The magical power is flowing backwards.
The polishing was successful,
but a powerful force strikes all heroes!
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10030_Find: Obtained 1 random item by searching the nearby area.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10040_Desc:
The statue of the God of Greed is broken.
Fortunately, its overall form is still intact.
Some parts even seem to remain undamaged.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10040_Pray:
Right after stepping out from a prayer to the God of Greed,
 you found a sack of Silver beneath your feet!
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10040_StealGold:
Red light flashes out from the eyes of the statue...
A while later, monsters appear out of nowhere.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10050_Desc:
A man approaches with eyes that gleam with madness. He starts talking, showing you a bag full of items.

“With these, I'll become as rich as the great Saleed...!
Take a look at these treasures! I can vouch for their quality!”
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10050_BuyRune: It didn't feel right, but you purchased a Rune from the man anyway.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10050_BuyConsume: It didn't feel right, but you purchased consumable(s) from the man anyway.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10050_Ignore:
“You low-lives will never understand their true value!”

The man disappears after throwing a fit…
A while later, monsters who heard his voice came out from nowhere!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10060_Desc:
The Great Rift must have swallowed this ancient research table at least centuries ago.
Despite all the piled-up dust, there are some useful items lying around.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10060_GetExpBook:
You found an old book
on the bookshelf.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10060_GetPotion: A couple of useful tools were found in the cupboard.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10070_Desc: In front of you is an ancient chest that seems to be corrupted by the void.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10070_Result_Eat_Desc: Look inside what is inside the chest.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10070_Result_Stomp_Desc: Swing the hammer to destroy the chest.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10070_GetUpStone: Inside the chest were Equipment Polishing Tool and Rune Polishing Tool.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10070_GetReward:
The items inside the chest were destroyed as well.
However, some remain intact.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10070_Fail:
It's a trap!
The dark force inside the chest engulfs all heroes.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10080_Desc:
Stepping into the icy room
has led you to the magical items at its center,
oozing out bone-chilling air.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_GetUpGradeStone: Obtain Equipment Polishing Tool and Rune Polishing Tool.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10080:
You obtained Polishing Tool,
but the hero is in pain due to extreme cold.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10090_Desc:
There is a jar with a drawing of the God of Greed.
Suddenly, a gust of wind blew out from inside and stole your Silver.
(-{0} Silver)
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10090_Option_PickUpGold: Put in your hand to search.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10090: You found items instead of Silver inside the jar!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10100_Desc:
A priest approaches with a telling smile and starts talking.

“I can tell that you are in pain. Let me be of help to you.”
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10100_Result_Heal_Desc: Request healing by offering a reward.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10100_Result_Bless_Desc: Request blessing by offering a reward.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_AllUnitHealed: All heroes healed {0}% of their HP.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_GetSuperShield: Grants +1 Mighty Block at the start of the next round
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10100_Heal: The priest's blessing healed wounds and injuries.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10100_Bless: The priest's blessing kindled a spirit of iron will.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10100_Fail: Upon receiving the reward, the priest vanished into thin air, only leaving behind a robe.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10110_Desc:
There are remains of a gigantic incarnate that seemed to have stopped moving a long time ago.
Below the remains are some shiny objects.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10111_Desc:
There are remains of a gigantic incarnate that seemed to have stopped moving a long time ago.
Below the remains are some shiny objects.

Would you like to search again?
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10110_Result_Search_Desc: Search the remains of the incarnate.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10110_Sucess: Below the remains were Silver and treasures.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10110_Fail:
Unfortunately, it turned out that this place is often visited by monsters...
They are preparing for battle.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10120_Desc: A Rune lies half-corrupted by the blazing abyss.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10121_Desc:
{0} took damage equal to {1}% of Max HP in an attempt to purify the Rune.

Would you like to try again?
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10120_Result_GetRuneFail_: Attempt to purify the corrupted Rune.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10120_Sucess: The corrupted Rune was slowly purified and returned to its original form.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10130_Desc:
A crossroads stands in the room.
Several shadows flicker on the left while a single shadow wavers on the right.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10130_Result_HelpHunter_D: Select the road where several shadows are flickering.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10130_Result_RobberHunter: Select the road where a single shadow is wavering.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10130_Left:
Monsters are running away after seeing your ally hero.
A treasure chest lies out in the open.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10130_Right: A hero at a dead end is showing the will to join your troop!
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10130_LeftFail:
The shadows belonged to monsters.
They are charging at the heroes.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10130_RightFail: Upon approaching the shadow, monsters suddenly came out running!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10140_Desc:
A man in a cloak tosses a coin high above his head and catches it.

“Would you like to make a bet with me? I think it's tails.
But, I'll give you the chance to guess first.”
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10150_Desc:
You see a clean sealing crate that has ancient Rune alphabets written on it.

Would you like to open it?
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10150_Result_Open_Desc: Where there is a crate, there is a treasure.
ar.RogueLikeEventOption_AddRandomEquip_Desc: Obtain {1} random pieces of {0} Tier equipment.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_BattleInUnit: Engage in battle with the following {0} monster included.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10150_Open: Upon opening the sealing crate, monsters suddenly jumped out from inside.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10150_FindOther: Useful equipment was obtained near the sealing crate.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10160_Desc:
An ancient language is inscribed on the Statue of Blood.
Despite all the damage to the statue, a few words can still be deciphered.

Blood... Sacrifice... Will gain... Power
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10161_Desc:
Blood... Sacrifice... Will gain... Power

The hero that offered blood gained power.
Would you like to proceed again?
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10160: The statue filled with red blood will soon be completely destroyed.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10170_Desc:
You notice an ancient writing inscribed on the Broken Statue of Heroes.

‘What does it take to become a true hero?’

Below, you see three buttons that you can press.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10170_Result_Exp_Desc: Select and grant {0} of EXP to one hero
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10170_Result_Armed_Desc: Enhances 2 random pieces of equipment or Runes by 1 Tier
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10170_Result_Share_Desc: Increases all heroes' EXP by {0} each
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10170_Exp:
The Statue of Heroes' eyes flash with blue light.
The experience of battle is smearing into the hero.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10170_Armed:
The Statue of Heroes' eyes flash with blue light.
Power is instilled into the items of heroes.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10170_Share:
The Statue of Heroes' eyes flash with blue light.
The heroes are looking at their companions.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10180_Desc:
Inside a large room is a dying bonfire.
There is no firewood to be seen, but there are a few books beside the bonfire.
ar.RogueLikeEventOption_AddRandomExpBook_De: Obtain {0} Book(s) of Power of random Tiers
ar.RogueLikeEventOption_HealToAllHeroPer_De: Heals all heroes by {0}% of their HP
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_GetRandomExpBook: You obtained {0} Book(s) of Power of random Tiers.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10180_Read: The bonfire's warmth shrouds your whole body.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10190_Desc:
You discovered soldiers of the east who have fallen.
From afar, monsters that seem to have battled these soldiers can be seen.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10190_Option_TrackDownPeo: Obtain a piece of equipment that has no owner.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_SelectEquipment: You can select 1 of {1} piece(s) of {0} Tier equipment.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10190_Monster: You track down monsters to start a battle.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10190_Human: You pay respect to the fallen soldiers and pick up their equipment.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10200_Desc:
Heroes have been captured and locked up in prison.
Someone is approaching from a distance.
You must move quickly to rescue the heroes.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10200_Sucess: The rescued hero wishes to join your troop.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10200_Fail:
The rescued hero wishes to join your troop.
But the guards are coming after you from afar.
It's time to get ready for battle.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10210_Desc:
A goblin with a sack of Silver is passing by.
Wait! There's a hole in the sack and Silver is falling out from it.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10210_Fishing: You picked up a lot of Silver by secretly following the goblin.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10210_Magick_Sucess:
The goblin fell!
You now have the goblin's sack to yourself.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10210_Magick_Fail:
The goblin is running away, drinking healing potions from its pocket.
It left behind several intact potions.

Obtained Healing Potion
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10220_Desc:
It's a trap! You're surrounded by a large number of enemies.

“Hehe, pay the price if you want to save your lives!”
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10220_Result_Fight_Desc: Your heroes draw their weapons immediately.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10220_Result_Pay_Desc: You compromise with the bandits and give them Silver.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10220_Fight: The bandits also take out their weapons to retaliate!
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10220_PaySucess: After taking the Silver, the bandits stand aside.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10220_PayFail:
Hehe, thanks for the Silver!
And now, your lives!

The treacherous enemies take out their weapons.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10250_Desc:
“Aram fell over!
If you help, Aram will give you good stuff!”
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10250_Option_Carry: Escort Aram to a safe place
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10250: You helped Aram and received her thanks.
ar.RogueLikeItemMerchantDesc: Come on, make an order! You can't skip meals even in the Great Rift!
ar.RogueLikeEquipMerchantDesc: If anything's broken, come to me. I'll at least be of help to you that way.
ar.RogueLikeRuneMerchantDesc: A place full of ancient Runes that were thought to be gone... I don't know if this is a gift or a curse.
ar.RogueLikeHeroMerchantDesc: You can bring heroes to the Great Rift or send them out through this dimension gate.
ar.RogueLikeRareItemMerchantDesc: Hey, you! If you're not buying, don't touch it! They're all precious goods, all right?
ar.RogueLikeBuilding5MerchantDesc: Money is a number that holds all the values of the world. It is therefore brilliant and sublime.
ar.RogueLikeTrialPanel_Reward: Obtain elite selection reward upon winning battle
ar.BuildingEffect_SpawnBuilding5Merchant: Merchant of Greed appears. Item refresh available {Value} time(s)
ar.BuildingEffect_SpawnBuilding5Merchant_Lo: Merchant of Greed appears with other merchants. The number of available item refresh increases.
ar.SkillDesc_70005:
Upon normal attack, opens a crack in the rift to summon random monsters.
 Upon using skill, pushes back all heroes and summons a troop of monsters.
ar.SkillDesc_70010: Forges weapon to use one of the following effects: Deals damage equal to {70011@Damage:AtkPer:BaseValue}% of ATK / {70012@AttackCount} normal attack(s) to all heroes / Deals {70013@Damage:MAtkPer} damage to all heroes and stuns them for {70013@StunTime} sec.
ar.SkillDesc_70030:
Always reflects {Unit@ReflectPerToAllEnemy}% of the damage it took to all heroes.
Returns the damage it took during skill to a single hero.
ar.SkillDesc_70045:
Enhances and uses a skill of a random monster.
Upon using skill, duplicates and uses the skill that dealt the most damage.
ar.SkillDesc_70065:
Does not take damage that exceeds {IgnoreDamageOverMaxHpPer}% of Max HP.
Every time {SkillTriggerHPRatio}% of HP is reduced, stuns nearby enemies and teleports to the opposite side.
Summons a hallucination when HP falls to 50% or below.
ar.SkillDesc_70070:
Takes reduced damage from nearby targets.
Upon using skill, charges to the target.
Upon being killed, enhances allies' Attack Speed by {700700@AttackSpeedPer}%.
ar.SkillDesc_70080:
Absorbs{Unit@ManaDrain} MP every {Unit@ManaDrainInterval} sec from all heroes within {Unit@ManaDrainRangeY} range of herself.
Upon using skill, retreats while pushing back nearby heroes and stunning the farthest enemy for {70085@StunTime} sec.
Upon being killed, enhances allies' Spell Power by {700800@MAtkPer}%.
ar.SkillDesc_700900:
Heals nearby allies.
When HP is reduced, calls for support from other allies.
Upon using skill, increases allies' Attack Speed by {AttackSpeedPer}% for {Time} sec.
Upon being killed, increases allies' HP Drain amount by {7009010@Drain}%.
ar.SkillDesc_70120:
Pulls 1 target every {GrabTimer} sec, starting with the nearest enemy, to deal {Damage:BaseValue}+{Damage:MAtkPer} damage.
When HP is reduced, skill and normal attacks are enhanced.
ar.RogueLikeRankingAlertMessage:
※ Rank will be listed after completely clearing Floor 9.
※ Rank calculation criteria may change, and the Ranking resets every Monday.
※ It takes about 10 minutes for the rank to be listed.
ar.RogueLikeCloneHighestLevelStatPer:
Summons the hallucination of the hero with the highest Tier.
The hallucination has {0} of the hero's ATK/Spell Power/Attack Speed/HP and additional 
abilities of equipment except Runes.
ar.BuildingEffect_MAtkPerByOverManaPer: Amplifies skill damage by {Value}% for every 1% of MP exceeded (max {MaxValue}%)
ar.PowerBookMissAlert: Can only be used on heroes of Tier {0} or lower.
ar.EquipHammerMissAlert: Can only be used on equipment of {0} or lower.
ar.RuneHammerMissAlert: Can only be used on Runes of {0} or lower.
ar.RogueLikeFinalBossCenterText_70100: You feel a roar that permeates the Great Rift in chaos...
ar.RogueLikeFinalBossCenterText_70110: You feel tens of thousands of glares beaming at you...
ar.RogueLikeFinalBossCenterText_70120: You feel an enormous force weighing down on your entire body...
ar.RogueLikeStoryPanel:
"...The vast darkness that shrouded the sky devoured everything there was."

 
"The Great Rift," that’s what people called it. 

Farmers sowing seeds, merchants selling goods,
heroes charging out into the battlefield, and even monsters...
All it took was a split second for a piece of this world to be sucked into the pitch-black swirl.
 
 
What remained was nothingness, and there the Great Rift planted unspeakable creatures of the void. 
They spewed dark energies that decayed and corrupted everything in their path, and it wasn’t long until the entire continent was devastated.

But there was one hero that remained unscarred by the Great Rift. Now, that hero is stepping out on a journey.
To rescue the friends and companions that had vanished into the rift,
and to find a way to put an end to this disaster, the hero seeks to enter the Great Rift.
 
 --
The Great Rift made sporadic appearances for millennia, swallowing pieces of this world to send them to the otherworldly space that was in its embrace.   
 
Here in the Great Rift, time flows differently, and you may encounter lost technologies, archaic magic and runes, and the disasters of ancient times.
 
Your hero must search the maze-like paths of the Great Rift to rescue companions, equip weapons, and obtain divine powers through relics.
 
And at the end of the rift, there might be a way to shut it down once and for all.

ar.OutgameTutorial_40_00:
We meet again, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.
We have recently fended off the invasion of the enemy and recovered the Dominion we once lost.

I shall aid the recovery of your desolated Dominion.
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_01: You do not have any Buildings in your Dominion. You can select an empty site and construct various buildings.
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_02: First, you must build a Chamber as a focal point to manage your Dominion.
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_03:
Constructions require costs to be paid.
My headquarters will aid you with the payment for this construction.
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_04: Select the site and construct the Chamber. (You can change the location of the building whenever you want after construction.)
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_05:
Your Dominion is fundamentally run by the Vitality that your heroes produce.
Therefore, you must build an Inn to work as a storage for their Vitality.
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_06:
Select the site and construct an Inn.
 (You can change the location of the building whenever you want after construction.)
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_07:
You can assign heroes in each building to boost its efficiency.
Various effects are applied according to the levels and classes of heroes.
ar.OutgameTutorial_40_08:
Your Dominion also has many other buildings you can construct aside from the Chamber and Inn.
I recommend you develop your Dominion in a unique way to enjoy various effects and expand the supply for your battles.

Good luck!

ar.SkinDesc_Default_10530: Aenrath was the watcher of the forest even long before the birth of the current Elven Prince. As fearful as he was of the darkness from the abyss that would reach the elves someday, Aenrath was also fascinated enough to study it. Like many who had fallen to become monsters after fighting so fiercely against them, the abyss tainted Aenrath's heart. One day, he vanished, leaving countless dead bodies of Elven watchers and a shard of a broken sword behind him.

ar.SkinDesc_1053000: Aenrath, known as the disciple of silence, stood as the captain of the watchers for centuries and protected the Eternal Forest long before Tia rose to his rank. To show her gratitude, the girl gifted the spirit 'Elizabeth,' a doll she cherished.

ar.TreasureDesc_10000: The Empire's chest armor is forged with the highest quality black iron, which is no exception for ordinary soldiers.
ar.TreasureDesc_10001: No knight has missed the stage of the training sword.
ar.TreasureDesc_10002: At the Mage Guild of the Empire, staves are researched as thoroughly as magic itself.
ar.TreasureDesc_10003: Trainees of the Phoenix family have swung wooden swords countless times to hone their rapid swordsmanship.
ar.TreasureDesc_10005: The totem of the Winter Lake Tribe brings peace to all nearby.
ar.TreasureDesc_10006: Orcs prove their power by hunting down powerful beasts and taking their molars as trophies.
ar.TreasureDesc_20000: The ones called the Shadows of the Empire are after you? How unfortunate... Best of luck to you.
ar.TreasureDesc_20001: Survival was never an option when the dragon became the target of Ragnir, the second brother of Orsali.
ar.TreasureDesc_20002: Knights of the Central Region practice their skills to pierce through the weak spots in between the joints of solid armor.
ar.TreasureDesc_20003: The grand beat of the drum that echoed throughout the mountains of the East mustered courage even within the hearts of those who had lost all hope.
ar.TreasureDesc_20004: The armor worn by elf warriors is imbued with magic that amplifies the effects of protection and favorable spells.
ar.TreasureDesc_20005: Many of those who constitute the army of the Central Region are commoners who do not possess remarkable strength. However, they rally under the knights' banner, upholding the dignified mission to protect their region, and will not hesitate to fight for honor and glory along with the knights.
ar.TreasureDesc_20006: The hammer infused with the power of light, wielded by the Southern Paladins, bring down punishment upon enemies and heals allies.
ar.TreasureDesc_20007: A manual of tactics essential for novice mercenaries. Although it contains a variety of seasoned strategies, it repeatedly focuses on the importance of adhering to the basics.
ar.TreasureDesc_30000: The first Elven King bestowed powerful swords and bows imbued with the force of the Eternal Forest upon the Watcher Captain of the Royal Guard. However, only the pieces of the sword's blade remained after Aenrath shattered it by Aenrath; Tia, the succeeding captain, inherited the bow.
ar.TreasureDesc_30001: The House of Juniper is known for its beautiful swordsmanship, resembling a dance of blooming flowers as their swords and steps blend to become one. When Ren grew to display her swordsmanship for her family, the sword blade passed down for generations was reforged into a weapon customized for her, as was the case for all those in her lineage who had followed the same path.
ar.TreasureDesc_30002: A holy relic created by Eldin and his paladins to combat the power of the abyss during the Great Holy War. Only those who possess the power and purity untainted by darkness may draw out the mystical power within the scroll.
ar.TreasureDesc_30003: Though the bearer of Mur suffered a stream of strife and war against countless enemies of formidable strength, the black shield and the indomitable will prevailed.
ar.TreasureDesc_30004: Among the Black Turtle's five holy objects, the Orb of Water has the power to manifest the inner image of others in the form of water. Most tide masters barely reach the level of creating such images, but Yeon's ingenious skills allow her to maintain their forms while communing with their inner selves at the same time.
ar.TreasureDesc_30005: When the void consumes our inner focus, the abyss may peer into us, forcing us to the verge of frustration and collapse through excruciating visions that let us behold nothing but despair. However, if we keep our eyes fixed on the light of hope amid the darkness, we will be able to blind the eyes of the abyss and defeat it.
ar.TreasureDesc_30006: A bloodstained orb that absorbs and emanates blood from its surroundings. The might of this blood, which governs the essence of all life, is grotesque yet magnificent.

You can equip Legacies to heroes to grant them Legacy Effects.

Identical Legacies are required to perform tier transcendence.

ar.StatInformationDesc_Hp: HP is reduced according to the value displayed after being hit. When HP is depleted, the hero stays defeated during that battle. HP is determined based on various factors, such as the hero's type, base HP according to the level, tier, and HP ratio.
ar.StatInformationDesc_Atk: ATK affects the damage of normal attacks and skills with ATK ratios. ATK is determined based on various factors, such as the hero's type, base ATK according to the level, tier, and ATK ratio.
ar.StatInformationDesc_MAtk: Spell Power affects the damage of skills with Spell Power ratios, the size of applied buffs, duration, and others. Spell Power is determined based on various factors, such as the hero's type, base Spell Power according to the level, tier, and Spell Power ratio.
ar.StatInformationDesc_AttackSpeed: Attack Speed affects the interval between normal attacks. It is determined based on various factors, such as the base Attack Speed according to the hero's type and Attack Speed ratio. Every time a hero's tier increases by one, their Attack Speed increases by 10%.
ar.StatInformationDesc_Range: Range indicates the distance reached by normal attacks. It also affects some skills that are influenced by its distance. Range is determined based on the hero's type. The cross shape shows that the hero's range is limited to the indicated number of blocks vertically and horizontally from the hero's position. The grid shape shows that the hero's range reaches anywhere within the area according to the indicated number. If a hero is dragged without dropping, the normal attack range is displayed in red, and the skill attack range is displayed in blue.
ar.StatInformationDesc_MoveSpeed: Movement Speed refers to the distance that can be traveled within a time frame. It is determined based on the type of the hero and can be increased or reduced by various factors, such as Relics and skill effects.
ar.StatInformationDesc_HybridDrain: HP Drain is the ability to restore a set percentage of the damage dealt as the HP of the hero. If it is specified as Physical/Spell, it applies to the corresponding damage type when restoring the HP. If nothing is specified, it applies to both physical and spell damage.
ar.StatInformationDesc_HybridDef: Physical DEF reduces physical damage received by 100 * [Physical DEF] / (900 + [Physical DEF])%. Spell DEF reduces spell damage instead of physical damage. If nothing is specified, the DEF stat will provide both Physical and Spell DEF by the indicated value.
ar.StatInformationDesc_Damage: Damage dealt increases or reduces the damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to increase or reduce the damage dealt, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence the damage dealt, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.
ar.StatInformationDesc_TakeDamage: Damage taken increases or reduces the damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to increase or reduce the damage dealt, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence the damage taken, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are multiplied by each other.
ar.StatInformationDesc_SkillDamageMul: Skill amplification increases or reduces skill damage and the damage derived from such damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to determining skill amplification, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence skill amplification, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.
ar.StatInformationDesc_AttackDamageMul: Normal attack amplification increases or reduces normal attack damage and the damage derived from such damage according to the specified value. Conditions may apply to determining normal attack amplification, which affects either the hero or the damage itself. When multiple factors influence normal attack amplification, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.
ar.StatInformationDesc_MissRatio: EVA grants a chance for attacks to be completely missed when a hero takes damage. If an attack misses, the hero negates all damage along with any accompanying status effects from the attack. The maximum chance to miss is limited to 80%.

ar.StatInformationDesc_CriticalDamageMul: Physical CRIT hits occur during physical attacks at a rate equal to the Physical CRIT Chance, increasing the damage by (25 + [Physical CRIT damage])%. If the physical/spell condition is not specified, the CRIT stat will apply to both Physical and Spell CRIT Chance and damage.
ar.StatInformationDesc_MCriticalDamageMul: Spell CRIT hits occur during spell attacks at a rate equal to the Spell CRIT Chance, increasing the damage by (25 + [Spell CRIT damage])%. If the physical/spell condition is not specified, the CRIT stat will apply to both Physical and Spell CRIT Chance and damage.
ar.StatInformationDesc_DefPen: Menace reduces the DEF of the target dealt damage by the equipped hero for 1.5 seconds. The reduced value is in proportion to the equipped hero's tier (x1 for tiers 1-2, x2 for tiers 3-4, x3 for tiers 5-6, x4 for tier 7). Even if multiple units influence the effect, only the highest DEF reduction value will be applied. The Menace value can be increased or reduced by equipment, accessories, and other factors. Besides its base effect, the Menace value can affect the performance of Legacies, Accessories, and others related to the Menace stat.
ar.StatInformationDesc_DefDen_0: Guard increases the DEF of the target that received beneficial effects, such as recovery, Protection gain, and stat increase from the equipped hero for 5 seconds. The increased value is in proportion to the equipped hero's tier (x1 for tiers 1-2, x2 for tiers 3-4, x3 for tiers 5-6, x4 for tier 7). Even if multiple units influence the effect, only the highest DEF increase value will be applied. The Guard value can be increased or reduced by equipment, accessories, and other factors. Besides its base effect, the Guard value can affect the performance of Legacies, Accessories, and others related to the Guard stat.
ar.StatInformationDesc_DefDen: Guard increases the DEF of an ally besides the user that received beneficial effects, such as recovery, Protection gain, and stat increase from the equipped hero for 5 seconds. The increased value is in proportion to the equipped hero's tier (x1 for tiers 1-2, x2 for tiers 3-4, x3 for tiers 5-6, x4 for tier 7). Even if multiple units influence the effect, only the highest DEF increase value will be applied. The Guard value can be increased or reduced by equipment, accessories, and other factors. Besides its base effect, the Guard value can affect the performance of Legacies, Accessories, and others related to the Guard stat.
ar.StatInformationDesc_SpecialDamageMul: Special damage is increased or reduced according to its relevant value. Special damage refers to any white damage derived from physical or spell damage. The amount of special damage is in proportion to the physical or spell damage that was originally dealt. Effects that increase special damage can be obtained from Accessory options and set effects. When multiple factors influence special damage, the damage is adjusted accordingly after the factors are summed up.

ar.TerritoryTycoonDescription:
- Beach Festival
Welcome to King God Castle's Summer Beach Festival. Construct buildings using Event Tokens and obtain Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens to buy items at the Beach Festival Shop!

- Event Token
At the Beach Festival, you can use Event Tokens to construct buildings. You can earn Event Tokens in content that requires Supplies, including Invasion, Investigation Team, and the Great Rift.

- Manage Buildings
You can construct buildings via "Manage Buildings." The buildings consist of Fisher, Stall, and Store, which can be constructed on Fishing Site, Stall Site, and Store Site, respectively. Please note you can only construct one of each building.

- Festival Level
Festival levels increase whenever you construct two buildings. The buildings you can build become more diverse as your festival level grows.

- Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens
The festival buildings produce a certain number of Bronze, Silver, or Gold Tokens per hour. The produced Bronze and Silver Tokens are collected automatically, while Gold Tokens must be claimed by tapping the token button.

- Festival Missions
Clear a wide range of daily and festival missions to obtain various currencies, including Event Tokens in addition to Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens!

- Festival Shop
Purchase consumables, summoning currencies, skins, and more using the Bronze, Silver, and Gold Tokens you've claimed!

ar.Cutscene_10000_30: Commander Evan, lead your knights back to the central region. After that, focus on defending against the monsters that emerged from the rift.

ar.Cutscene_10000_210: You know there's no need to ask me. I'm going to avenge Kalina.
ar.Cutscene_10000_220: Well, it seems like it's our turn to decide.

ar.Cutscene_10000_250: Okay! Time to show off our abilities!

ar.ClanRaidBossGuideText_41000:
The Hero Incarnate uses the  skill to summon up to 4 Great Warriors.
We recommend heroes who use skills with wide ranges to deal damage to a large number of Great Warriors.
ar.ClanRaidBossGuideText_41100:

You need heroes who can change positions using their skills.
ar.ClanRaidBossGuideText_41200:
The Blood Incarnate uses the  skill to obtain Mighty Block for each enemy hit by the skill.
We recommend deploying only a few heroes who can quickly strike the opponent multiple times.
ar.ClanRaidBossGuideText_41300:
The Giant Incarnate uses the  skill to push heroes back.
You need heroes who can support others and prevent them from being pushed back.
ar.ClanRaidBossGuideText_41400:
The Mage Incarnate uses the  skill to block heroes from using their skills and reduces its spell damage taken.
You must ensure that heroes use their skills before the Incarnate uses .
ar.ClanRaidBossGuideText_41500:
The Greed Incarnate uses the  skill to reduce its damage taken.
Since  is removed when the Incarnate is stunned, we recommend heroes who can stun their opponent.
ar.ClanRaidBossGuideText_42200:
The Herald of Blood's damage taken changes according to .
Since  is reduced when the Herald of Blood heals its , we recommend heroes with healing abilities.

ar.OutgameTutorial_90_00:
Greetings, King of Humans. It has been a while.

I am Luminesera, the Oracle of the Eternal Forest.
ar.OutgameTutorial_90_01:
You have bravely overcome formidable foes of the past. Congratulations.

However, the battles ahead will be challenging, as the enemies you will face in the future possess transcendental strength.
ar.OutgameTutorial_90_02:
I, Luminesera, will assist you.

Let's together thwart the darkness within Memories of Eternity.
ar.OutgameTutorial_90_03:
Powerful elite monsters are strengthening the boss.

If you defeat the elite monsters using special methods, you can weaken the boss.
ar.OutgameTutorial_90_04:
We've recorded the weaknesses of the elite monsters through the memories of the Eternal Forest.

Click on the eye to check their weaknesses.
ar.OutgameTutorial_90_05:
By targeting the weaknesses of each round's elite enemy, you can weaken the boss's skill.

If you fail to do so, you'll face a powerful boss, so I recommend you target the weaknesses.
ar.OutgameTutorial_90_06:
Your Majesty,

It may be difficult, but I believe that with the heroes by your side, you can overcome even transcendent beings. Trust in the heroes who accompany you and move forward.

There is also Shard of Growth that substitutes the Gold cost required for hero level-up,

Cube of EXP that allows you to obtain the EXP required for hero level-up,

and Cube of Power that can substitute both the Gold and EXP required for hero level-up.
ar.OutgameTutorial_100_05: Among them, Cube of Power is only applicable to heroes at level 9 or below.
ar.OutgameTutorial_100_06:
I hope you quickly power up your heroes and defend the castle by using Cube of Power.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_110_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

The new mode Expedition has been unlocked! Let me briefly explain about the Expedition.
ar.OutgameTutorial_110_01:
Expedition is a game mode that can be played with different rules from Invasion.

To play Expedition, you need the exclusive resource Expedition Flag.
Every day, 6 Flags are recharged.
ar.OutgameTutorial_110_02:
Each Expedition has different game rules,
and the Expeditions you can play vary by day of the week.

You can obtain various rewards in Expeditions.
ar.OutgameTutorial_110_03: In Golblin Hunt Down!, you can obtain Gold after defeating the golblins.
ar.OutgameTutorial_110_04: In Elite Invasion!, you can obtain Book of EXP after defeating the powerful enemies of each invasion.
ar.OutgameTutorial_110_05: In Hero Invasion?!, you will face other heroes and can obtain Pass Points.
ar.OutgameTutorial_110_06:
I hope you defend the castle successfully by obtaining the desired items from Expeditions each day of the week.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

I came after hearing the news that the new region Tower of Trials has opened.
Let me guide you through the Tower of Trials.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_01: Tower of Trials is a new game mode with a play style different from Invasion.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_02: Press the Enter button to enter the Tower of Trials.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_03:
Tower of Trials consists of one battle per floor.
Each time you clear a floor, you will move onto a higher floor.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_04:
In Tower of Trials, equipment with fixed effects is provided,
and you can check it here.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_05:
In Tower of Trials, Altar effects are not applied.
You will set up heroes and Relics for battle.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_06:
After entering, you can proceed with the battle manually.
There is also an Auto-Proceed feature where heroes battle automatically.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_07:
If you clear a floor,
you can obtain the following rewards.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_08: If you purchase the Tower of Trials Pass, you can also obtain the following additional rewards.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_09: Tower of Trials exists in each region.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_10:
For example, unlike the "Tower of Trials" where you could select all heroes,

in the {0}, only {1} region heroes can be selected.
ar.OutgameTutorial_120_11:
I hope you conquer all the Towers of Trials.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

I came after hearing the news that you can now join an.
Let me guide you through the Alliance.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_01:
An Alliance is a place where you can interact and cooperate with other kings.

You can exchange conversations with each other,
and through Alliance support, you can complement each other's lacking Hero EXP.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_02:
Additionally, through Alliance Raid and Alliance skills, etc.,
you can gain various beneficial effects by cooperating with each other.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_03: Here, you can search for a specific Alliance and join.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_04:
Additionally, to find an Alliance suitable for you,

you can set the language primarily used in the Alliance and
the keywords pursued by the Alliance.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_05:
By clicking on the Alliances here, you can check the info of each Alliance,
and you can also join one.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_06: If there is no Alliance to your liking, you can create one yourself.
ar.OutgameTutorial_130_07:
I hope you can enhance your reputation by being part of an Alliance that overcomes hardships together.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_150_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

{0} has reached level 16 and can now be Awakened.
Let me guide you through Awakening.
ar.OutgameTutorial_150_01:
When a hero is Awakened, they can use one of the two Awakened Abilities to become more powerful.
Please check each Awakened Ability.
ar.OutgameTutorial_150_02:
To use these abilities, you must Awaken the hero.
You can proceed with Awakening through Hero Growth, similar to leveling up.
ar.OutgameTutorial_150_03:
To Awaken a hero, in addition to the EXP and Gold,
you need an item called Hero's Token.
Hero's Tokens possessed by the hero are displayed in the designated area.
ar.OutgameTutorial_150_04:
You can obtain Hero's Tokens mainly from Hero Summon,
and you can also convert King's Tokens below to Hero's Tokens.
ar.OutgameTutorial_150_05:
Additionally, Hero's Tokens are used not only for Awakening,
but also for level-up after Awakening.
ar.OutgameTutorial_150_06:
I hope you have an easier time defending the castle
by using the Awakened Abilities of heroes.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

Let me guide you about forging Relics.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_01:
Forging is a way to make Relics stronger.

I will explain using the Relic I have.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_02: Forging is a system that allows you to change the Relic options, through which you can maximize synergy with heroes.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_03: Forging is only possible for King God Relics. You can enter the forging window by pressing the Forge button.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_04: Through forging, the following options are all changed randomly.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_05:
If there are options you do not wish to change,
you can press the lock button on the right to keep those options.
If more options are locked, the forging cost increases.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_06: If you have decided on the options to change, now select the material.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_07:
You can add a same Relic or Forge Stone in the material slot.

The higher the grade of the selected material, the lower the forging cost.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_08:
Then, you can select a Catalyst.
A Catalyst can adjust the values of the changing options to some extent.
Depending on the type of Catalyst, it can make only specific types of options appear,
and it can also make only options of specific phases or higher appear.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_09: Let's use the King God Shining Catalyst that makes all options appear only at phase 3 or higher.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_10:
If you have decided on the options to change, the material, and the Catalyst, you can now pay the cost and start forging.
You can start forging by paying with Gems or Gold, but if you use a high-grade Forge Stone like now, the cost becomes 0.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_11: Press the Yes button to start forging.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_12: If you have forged, you can compare the Relic before forging and after forging.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_13:
Each time you forge, a value called Forging Energy increases.
When this Forging Energy reaches 100%,
you obtain a Polishing Stone, a material that allows you to change Relic options.

I will explain 'polishing' and 'Polishing Stones' later.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_14:
You can immediately retry forging by pressing the Reforge button.
You can check the materials, Catalysts, and currency consumed during forging here.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_15: If you think the options after forging are better, you can press the After button to change the Relic to those options.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_16:
Conversely, if you think the options before forging are better, you can press the Before button to keep the options as they are.

I will press the Before button to keep the options.
ar.OutgameTutorial_160_26:
I hope your Relics also become stronger through forging.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

This time, let me guide you about polishing Relics.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_01:
Polishing is a way to perfect forged Relics.

I will explain using the Relic I have.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_02:
Polishing, like forging, is only possible for King God Relics,
and it can be done in the following location.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_03: First, I will select one of my Relics.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_04:
When you use polish, you can select one of the Relic's options,

and perform one action between Enhance and Move Position.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_05: Enhance enhances the selected Relic option by one phase.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_06:
If you select Move Position,
it moves the position of the selected Relic option.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_07: I will use Enhance among these to enhance the Relic option to a higher phase.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_08: Polishing uses Polishing Stones that can be obtained during forging.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_09:
Each Polishing Stone fills the Polishing Gauge by a set value.

The Polishing Gauge varies depending on the selected option's phase and other factors.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_10:
If the gauge is full, you can start polishing.

You can preview the results of polishing here.
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_11: My Relic has become a bit more perfect this way!
ar.OutgameTutorial_170_12:
I hope you will also perfectly defend the castle with Relics that have become more perfect through polishing.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_180_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

Now, you are qualified to participate in .
ar.OutgameTutorial_180_01:
Strife Battlefield is a mode where you compete in real time by interacting with other kings.

In Strife Battlefield, you send monsters to other kings
and defend against monsters sent by other kings.
ar.OutgameTutorial_180_02:
You can select the Troop to use in Strife Battlefield.

This slot reflects the settings of the Barracks slots but does not affect the Barracks slots in return.
ar.OutgameTutorial_180_03:
In Strife Battlefield, there is a system called Hero Stats Adjustment.

Certain heroes can perform better in Strife Battlefield.
ar.OutgameTutorial_180_04: Here, you can check the current stats adjustment of the heroes in the Troop you have selected.
ar.OutgameTutorial_180_05: Additionally, by pressing this button, you can check the current stats adjustment of all released heroes.
ar.OutgameTutorial_180_06:
In Strife Battlefield, you are primarily matched with random opponents,
but you can also gather with desired kings to proceed with a Friendly Battle.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

I would like to show you how to transcend the Legacy you have obtained.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_01:
Tier transcendence is a system that can grant additional effects to the abilities of a Legacy.

Please tap on a Legacy to check its info.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_02: Here, you can easily check the transcendence effects.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_03: Press the Tier Transcendence button to transcend the tier of the selected Legacy.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_04: All Legacies can go through a total of 10 tiers of transcendence.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_05:
Each time you transcend the tier of a Legacy,

you can grant additional effects to the Legacy.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_06:
Additionally, when a Legacy's transcendence tier increases,

the maximum level of a Legacy increases in proportion to its rarity.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_07: To transcend the tier of a Legacy, you must use an identical Legacy as material.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_08:
If you do not have an identical Legacy,

you can use a special item called Transcendence Ingot as material.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_09:
Transcendence Ingot can be used as material for any Legacy,

but the cost of selecting materials may increase depending on the rarity.
ar.OutgameTutorial_190_10:
You can now transcend your Legacies to defend your castle more effectively.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Commander Aslyn.

Let me guide you about enhancing Accessories.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_01:
Accessories have their own levels, and you can enhance them by leveling them up.

Please select an Accessory.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_02: You can level up Accessories using the Enhance button.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_03: Here, you can proceed with the enhancement.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_04:
The secondary stat of an Accessory is unlocked based on the rarity and level of the Accessory.

Each time you level it up, the following secondary stats are added or enhanced.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_05: When the accumulated EXP on an Accessory exceeds a certain amount, the level of the Accessory increases.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_06:
By selecting enhancement materials, you can grant EXP to an Accessory.

The enhancement material, Accessory Piece, can be obtained by dismantling other Accessories.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_07: When enhancing Accessories, a certain amount of Gold is also required in addition to enhancement materials.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_08: Additionally, you can automatically select materials to quickly increase to the corresponding level.
ar.OutgameTutorial_200_09:
I hope you defend the castle with greater strength through enhancing Accessories.

Good luck.
ar.OutgameTutorial_20_10:
When you equip a Relic, there is an effect that grants additional stats to heroes besides the basic abilities.

This is called Relic option.
ar.OutgameTutorial_20_11:
Relic options have effects that increase HP, ATK, Attack Speed, and Spell Power,

and grant these additional effects to heroes in the following positions.
ar.OutgameTutorial_20_13:
Relic options are unleashed one by one as the Relic's tier increases,

and when reaching the highest tier, King God Tier, each Relic can receive 4 Relic options.

ar.RogueLikeEvent_10320_Desc:
Two dice are resting on the ancient Altar of Mage.
The inscription on the Altar reads:

"I bestow upon thee a sorcery, guided by fate' hand."
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_HighEliteReward_Tri: Receive a stronger elite selection reward three times!
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_HighEliteReward: Receive a stronger elite selection reward!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10330_Desc:
You find a treasure chest near a sleeping monster.

You may be able to take the treasure before the monster wakes up.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10331_Desc:
The monster is still sleeping!

It looks like you can try taking another treasure.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10340_Desc:
A blacksmith, retired from civilization, offers his aid.

"What can I do for you? Is there a piece of equipment you'd like me to temper?"
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10350_Desc:
You hear a voice beyond the closed door.

"Could you open this door, sir?
Apologies for the delay—I got lost along the way!"

The voice sounds familiar, but you cannot lower your guard.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10350_OpenShop: You open the door and see the shopkeeper standing before you.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10350_Battle: You open the door, ready for battle, and a horde of monsters charge at you!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Desc:
A man, his scent thick with medicine, appears with an offer.

"Why don't you take part in my research? I swear, I'll enhance every part of you!"
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Change_Desc: Randomly enhance equipped equipment and Runes.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Change_Narrative:
KABOOM!

The man douses your equipment in mysterious liquid,
and then an explosion erupts, sending a green cloud billowing through the air!

When the smoke clears, you notice that all your equipment and Runes have completely transformed!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10360_Result_Change_Desc:
All equipped equipment and Runes are transformed
into random equipment and Runes that are 1 tier higher.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10370_Desc:
You find a chest that can be opened by letting blood.

Immense rewards lie dormant within, but to claim them, a great blood sacrifice must be made.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10370_Open:
The chest finally opens,

but your heroes suffer grievous wounds!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10380_Desc: You come across a suspicious man who claims he can create a flawless copy of anything.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10380_Result_Duplicate_De: Select a Rune or equipment at God tier or below to make its copy.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10380_Result_Fail_Desc: Select a Rune or equipment at God tier or below to reduce its tier by 1.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_success_Narra:
"Haha, relax! To me, this is as easy as taking candy from a baby!"

The replication succeeds!
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_Fail_Narrativ:
"Huh? How did this happen? Ugh, this must be my unlucky day."

The man damages your item and vanishes...
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_success: Obtain an item that is an exact copy of the equipment/Rune you selected.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_10380_Fail: The tier of the equipment/Rune you selected decreases by 1.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10390_Desc:
You stumble upon a small, silent shrine.

It seems to offer a divination service in exchange for Silver.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10390_Result_Omikuji_Desc: Donate {0} Silver and unveil your fate.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_AddAllRewardBuff: Obtain +{0}% Silver, HP Recovery, EXP rewards ({1} round(s))
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Desc:
A Golblin greets you with an enticing offer.

"Welcome! We've got some especially tempting goods, just for you! And just this once, I'll let you have 'em for free!"
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Invest_Desc: Obtain King tier Saving Rune x{0}
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Invest_Succe: You took the Golblin's offer, and it paid off!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Listen_Name: Ask the Golblin about their secret to success.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Listen_Narra: You asked the Golblin to share his secret to success!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Attack_Narra: You attacked the Golblin and obtained Silver!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10400_Result_Invest_Fail: Unfortunately, the investment failed, and the Golblin ran away...
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Desc:
"I'm furious! Absolutely livid!"

A man rants, overcome with anger.
ar.RogueLikeEventResult_EliteReward_Twice: Receive an elite selection reward twice.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Talk_Narrati:
"Seems I let anger get the best of me. My apologies."

Thanks to you, the man regains his composure, leaving behind a small token of gratitude before departing.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Talk_Reroll: Change the probability of the other two choices.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10411_Desc:
"Listen, this is just absurd! It just makes no sense!"

The man seems to be angry still.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_GiveMoney_Su:
"I...don't know why you're giving me this Silver, but...you've managed to calm me down."

The man is perplexed by your action but hands you a small reward after calming down.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_GiveMoney_Fa:
"Are you taking me for a beggar?!"

The man starts cursing at you out of anger.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Attack_Succe:
With no other options to pacify him, the heroes take up their arms.

They succeed in subduing the man...but not without suffering wounds.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10410_Result_Attack_Fail:
You dare raise your weapons against me?!

Seeing your heroes prepare for battle,
the man charges at them, inflicting serious wounds.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10420_Desc:
You encounter a monster and hastily ready yourself for battle,

but the monster merely twirls its hand and says,

"I can't be bothered to fight, so why don't you just keep going your way? All I want is to lie here a while longer."
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10420_Result_Attack_Narra:
"Ugh, how annoying..."

Frustrated by your decision, the monster imbues its hand with magic and waves it.

A sudden wave of lethargy grips the heroes, just as a swarm of monsters ambushes them!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10430_Desc:
A figure approaches you with a bottle.
It exudes a sweet aroma.

"I bring you an offer you can't refuse. Drink."
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10430_Result_Drink_Narrat:
Upon drinking the liquid from the bottle, your heroes feel their blood surge.

"Sweet things often mask hidden dangers. Enjoy."

With those parting words, the figure vanishes.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Desc:
"You there, I find myself rather thirsty. Fetch me some tea, at once."

A man, draped in garments so lavish they seem freshly woven from the crack in the Rift, is sitting gracefully and gazing down at you.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_GiveItem_Hid:
The man takes the potion and speaks with a satisfied look.

"Impressive. You shall be rewarded accordingly."
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_TakeRewardHi: Receive a selection reward of a higher Tier!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_GiveItem_Nar:
"I made it clear I was thirsty. Nonetheless, I shall accept this gift with gratitude. Take your reward."

The man hands you Silver with a hint of dissatisfaction and departs.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_Attack_Narra:
"You would strike a man when he is at a disadvantage?!"

Furious, the man breaks past your heroes and flees.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10440_Result_Ignore_Fail:
"Such insolence! You dare ignore me?!"

You try to ignore the man, but he lunges at you in a fury.
You and your heroes manage to retreat, but one suffers injuries in the process.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Desc:
A monster gnawing on a piece of iron shouts at you.

"Help! I'm starving to death! Give me something—anything—to eat!"
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Result_GiveItem_Low:
"Graaack! It's not enough!"

The monster devours your items, yet its hunger seems to be unquenched.
It clutches its hungry belly and vanishes into the unknown...
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Result_GiveItem_Nor:
"Whew, you saved me. I thought I was done for."

With its hunger sated, the monster seems eager to offer you a reward.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10450_Result_GiveItem_Hig:
"That was a feast to remember!"

The monster pats its belly and continues.

"As a reward, I'll grant you tiny bits of my scales!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Desc:
A man, carrying an abundance of Runes under his clothes, walks toward you and yells.

"Your Runes look way better than mine! Let's trade!"
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Result_ChangeRune_L:
Following the exchange, the man carefully examines the Rune and says,

"Wait a minute... This is worse than what I gave you! Ugh, dang it!"

The man storms off in anger.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Result_ChangeRune_H:
Just as the exchange takes place, the man suddenly snaps.

"No, I change my mind! I'm taking yours and keeping mine!"

In greed, he summons monsters and attacks you!
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10460_Result_HasNoRune_De:
"Wait, now that I see you more clearly, you have nothing!"

The man gazes at you and hands you a rune before going his way.

"Just toss it aside along the way!"
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10470_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

In the center of the rift with a ferocious mana storm,
you see the silhouette of a colossal raptor take shape.
Its form pulses with energy sharp as lightning itself, overflowing with mana.
Then, the entity speaks, its voice echoing like thunder.

"My old comrades, I offer you my power to aid in your journey, should you wish it."

The thunder hawk silently unfurls its wings, preparing to bestow its might upon you.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10470_Result:
"Good! May the winds of fortune carry you ever forward!”

The thunder hawk hands you a radiant feather gleaming with five distinct colors.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10480_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

It is an acrid world with the smell of steel and smoke.
The entity is familiar, yet peculiar.
It resembles the spirit you and your heroes have known,
except its form is made not of stone but of solid steel.
And though its body is of metal, the warmth of its heart is unmatched. Cautiously, it speaks, its voice laced with an electronic sound.

"Expression of will: Joining your journey forward."

The Spirit of Steel readies itself, prepared to remove a part of its own body and give it to you.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10480_Result:
The spirit's part drifts around you.

"Partial synchronization complete. Activating perpetual defense system."

Its voice hums with happiness.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10490_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

It is the Eternal Forest that grew beyond the rules or reasons of the world.
From eternity that silences even silence itself, she gazes upon you,
her presence woven between roots untouched by light and branches tangled endlessly.
Once a tiny spirit of this boundless grove, she has weathered countless cycles of end and beginning, rising at last as its last guardian.
Breaking the silence, she speaks.

"Visitors from another world, I do not wish for you to bear the burden of our sins.”

She unleashes a part of her strength from the forest and gives it to you.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10490_Result:
The power she bestows takes form. It is a flower.

"Worry not, visitors. Every spirit of the Eternal Forest will come to your aid."
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10500_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

His form resembles someone who has succumbed to power in this world.
Yet, this being from the rift has not yet fallen. He gazes at you with deep eyes and speaks.

"Through this rift, I glimpsed my future...
and saw that what I accepted was not power
but a catalyst for an endless descent.
As such, I wish to end this path here."

The young prince launches an orb shaped like an eye, ready to accompany you on your journey.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10500_Result:
The eye-like magic orb ascends in silence, casting its light upon the path ahead.
The prince says,

"I shall join you and lend you my knowledge...for my demise."
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10510_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

She weeps in silence, clutching a doll tightly in her arms.
Once hailed as the empire's greatest swordswoman, she now carries the weight of failure.
She failed to protect her sibling.
With great effort, she suppresses sorrow and molds it into fury.

"The blood price must be paid for the sake of my ruined world,"
says the avenger as she hands you a dagger, its blades still slick with fresh blood.

"Take it. I shall follow you after spilling blood."
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10510_Result:
As you take her dagger,
she turns, striding in the opposite direction. Her eyes burn with resolve.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10520_Title: The Hero and the Dark Lord
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10520_Desc:
You encounter an entity inside the rift of a different dimension.

Once a hero, the Dark Lord completed her world in another rift.
However, her world crumbled within the Dimensional Rift, drowning her in sorrow once again.
The once-hero speaks.

"Do you seek my strength?
Then prove that you have the courage to face it."

The hero, who was once the Dark Lord, prepares to grant you her strength.
ar.RogueLikeEvent_10520_Result:
The great power of the world flows into you.

"Go."

With that final word, she vanishes...

ar.OutgameTutorial_140_00:
Greetings, King of the Castle. It's been a while. I am Knight Commander Aslyn.

I would like to explain about the Vanguard hero in the Barracks.
ar.OutgameTutorial_140_01:
Vanguard hero is one of the elements that can be strategically utilized in King God Castle.

After you start an Invasion or Expedition, when summoning heroes 8 times or less, only the Vanguard hero is summoned.
ar.OutgameTutorial_140_02:
By utilizing this, you can designate a Vanguard hero
to start the battle with an advantage.
ar.OutgameTutorial_140_03:
Now, let's designate a Vanguard hero.
Please press the Designate Vanguard button.
ar.OutgameTutorial_140_04: Please designate one of the deployed heroes as a Vanguard hero.
ar.OutgameTutorial_140_05:
Well done.

Only one Vanguard hero can be designated, and you may change to another hero or choose not to designate a Vanguard hero.
ar.OutgameTutorial_140_06:
Additionally, if you play with15 points of Altar of Greed,
you can summon heroes 8 times with the initial Silver, allowing you to quickly make use of the strategy.
ar.OutgameTutorial_140_07:
I hope you defend the castle successfully by strategically using the Vanguard hero.
Good luck.
ar.IngameTutorial_1_01:
Greetings, King of the Castle. I am Knight Commander Aslyn.

ar.IngameTutorial_1_01_2:
King God Castle is a precarious castle frequently besieged by monster invasions. Goblins are trying to breach the castle gate as we speak.

Please, let me explain how to navigate the battle through this round and assist you in defending King God Castle excellently.

When we lose a battle, we get to face the enemies once again.

Even when we are defeated, we will be granted a small amount of Silver so that we can reinforce our Troop.

You can play the next level
after successfully defending a Chapter.

You can play the next Chapter once you clear the Normal level.

King of the Castle, I'm here to deliver urgent news.
We have enemies corrupted by mysterious power
marching toward our castle.

I've got a Relic Piece with me.

and each Relic option grants a different value depending on its phase.

Additionally, when reaching King God Tier,
you can also proceed with forging to change the Relic options.

ar.OutgameTutorial_210_00:
We meet again, King of the Castle. I am Knight Commander Aslyn.

This time, I will show you how to initiate battles against enemy invasions.
ar.OutgameTutorial_210_01: You can initiate the battle from the Gate tab. We must defend our castle against the Goblins right now.
ar.OutgameTutorial_210_02: You can begin the battle with the prepared heroes by tapping the Battle button.
ar.OutgameTutorial_210_03: May you lead us to victory with excellent command!
ar.OutgameTutorial_4_00:
King of the Castle, to fight against the strengthening monsters, you must utilize the power of the Altars.

This time, I will show you how to upgrade the Altars to effectively stop the monsters.
ar.OutgameTutorial_4_01: At the Altar, you can gain beneficial effects for battles by using the Altar Embers given to you.
ar.OutgameTutorial_4_02:
The Altar Ember can be expanded once each time the Castle level increases by 1.
Try expanding the Ember.
ar.OutgameTutorial_4_03:
Use the expanded Embers to grant them to the Altar of Greed.
(Tap the Altar for more details.)
ar.OutgameTutorial_4_04:
You can always 
retrieve and grant Embers at the Altars according to your strategy.
ar.OutgameTutorial_4_05:
The effects of the Altar of Greed, empowered by the Embers, will now be applied to the battlefield.
Utilize the power of the Altars to successfully defend the castle!
ar.OutgameTutorial_30_00: Greetings, King of the Castle. The time has come for you to gain the power of new heroes to face stronger monsters.
ar.BeginnerHelp_10100: You can further strengthen a hero by selecting them in the Barracks. As they level up, battles will become much easier. Please empower the heroes!
ar.BeginnerHelp_10300: Would you like to use the Altars in the Barracks? They can provide you with power that greatly aids in battle. As you expand the Embers, the Altars also become stronger, making your journey ahead more secure.
ar.BeginnerHelp_10500: The Altar Ember can be expanded once each time the Castle level increases. It can be expanded up to a maximum of 25, so take your time to upgrade it. As the Ember grows, the Altars will shine more beautifully.
ar.BeginnerHelp_10501: You can retrieve and grant the Altar Ember at any time. Feel free to make use of it.
ar.BeginnerHelp_10700: In the Blacksmith of the Barracks, you can craft Relics that provide significant strength in battle. Properly assigning the completed Relics will give you a great advantage in battle!
ar.BeginnerHelp_11000: Have you tried opening the Relic Chest in the summoning tab? They are filled with materials necessary for crafting Relics. If you have gathered the materials, try crafting a wonderful Relic at the Blacksmith!
ar.BeginnerHelp_11001: Have you visited the Dominion? Constructing buildings in the Dominion can make your heroes stronger.
ar.BeginnerHelp_11300:
If you designate a Vanguard hero in the Barracks, that hero will appear first in the first 8 summons after the game starts. Make sure to set it if you want to summon the hero you want quickly.
And... since I am a supporter, please don't send me as a Vanguard!
ar.BeginnerHelp_11500: Legacies are special equipment that awaken the true power of heroes. If you equip a hero with a Legacy, they can exert much more powerful strength in battle.
ar.BeginnerHelp_11501: Legacies can be enhanced. By enhancing or combining the same Legacy, you will be granted more power.
ar.BeginnerHelp_13000: Accessories are precious equipment that draw out the potential of heroes. However, you must clear 'Corruption Invasion II' to obtain them, so prepare well and take on the challenge.

ar.KGMarbleEventRuleContent:
Select a hero, roll the dice, and play King God Dice!

Each hero has unique effects, and by rolling the dice, you can encounter various rewards and events.

Each time you reach or pass the starting point and complete a lap, the tiles change randomly, and you can obtain additional rewards based on the number of laps completed.
